### Premium and claim reminders <!-- F-INS-022 -->
**What it does:** Creates alerts in **Alerts** for each active policy's next premium: 30, 15, 7 and 1 days before and on the due day ("<insurer> — <plan> premium due in N days", "… premium is due today"), during the grace period ("… premium overdue — N days of grace left", again in the last 5 days), and after it ("… may have lapsed" or, with no grace, "… cover has ended"). For claims, it alerts once when it is time to raise a complaint and once when you can take it to the Insurance Ombudsman.

**Why it exists:** "You'll get reminders before each premium" (empty-state text).

**Where to find it:** Alerts appear in **Alerts** (D-INS-001) and the alerts bell; there is no page of its own.

**Who can use it:** All signed-in users with active policies or open claims; R-MANAGER's managed person gets their own.

**Steps:** Not applicable — automatic.

**Controls:** None.

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable.

**Settings and toggles here:** S-INS-003 and S-INS-004 decide the dates.

**Results:** Alerts are created once per premium and step (keys carry the due date), so next year's premium gets fresh reminders.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Reminder for a premium you paid | The payment isn't recorded, or its period is in a different month | Record it (F-INS-006, F-INS-007) |

**Limitations:** Runs once a day at 20:45 IST; a skipped day is caught up (the nearest of 30/15/7/1 days is used). Policies due more than 120 days ago are no longer reminded. Matured or lapsed policies keep being reminded because the status can't be changed in the app.

**How it works:** The daily alert scan (`ENABLE_ALERT_CRONS`) runs `generateRenewalAlerts` and `generateClaimAlerts` per user under that user's database context. Alert types `INSURANCE_PREMIUM` and `INSURANCE_CLAIM`. An API route `POST /api/insurance/alerts/trigger` also creates today's premium reminders for the caller (no UI button).

**Related features:** F-INS-006, F-INS-012, D-INS-001.

**Sources:** `packages/api/src/services/insurance/insurance.service.ts:71`, `packages/api/src/services/insurance/insurance.service.ts:73`, `packages/api/src/services/insurance/insurance.service.ts:75`, `packages/api/src/services/insurance/insurance.service.ts:1106`, `packages/api/src/services/insurance/insurance.service.ts:1235`, `packages/api/src/services/notifications/alerts.service.ts:360`, `packages/api/src/jobs/alertJobs.ts:48`

### Premiums matched from bank and payment emails <!-- F-INS-023 -->
**What it does:** When an approved email event of type "premium paid" is turned into a cash-flow entry, EveryPaisa tries to link it to one of your active policies and records the premium payment.

**Why it exists:** To mark premiums paid without manual entry. Stated in code comments.

**Where to find it:** The result appears in the policy's **Premiums** card (F-INS-007).

**Who can use it:** Users whose inbox events are approved (D-INS-007).

**Steps:** Not applicable — automatic.

**Controls:** None.

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable.

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** A premium payment dated today, covering the premium that was next due, linked to the email event.

**Errors and troubleshooting:** None shown; a failed match is logged only.

**Limitations:** The payment's **Paid on** is the day the event was processed, not the email's date. Matching needs the policy number in the event, or exactly one active policy whose insurer name matches and whose premium is within ±5% of the amount.

**How it works:** `hookAutoMatchPremiumPayment` is called by the projection pipeline after a PREMIUM_PAID event; policy number by fingerprint first, then insurer + amount.

**Related features:** F-INS-007, D-INS-007.

**Sources:** `packages/api/src/services/insurance/insurance.service.ts:986`, `packages/api/src/services/insurance/insurance.service.ts:1033`, `packages/api/src/services/insurance/insurance.service.ts:1054`

### What this area doesn't do

- You can't change a policy's status (Lapsed, Surrendered, Matured, Claimed) from any screen.
- You can't enter health-cover details (members, room rent, co-pay, sub-limits) or link a vehicle from the policy form.
- Recording a claim, nominee or premium here doesn't notify the insurer.
- There is no bulk import of policies other than the Gmail search.
- Family view does not show other members' policies on these pages.

## PPF & EPF

The **PPF & EPF** page (sidebar **Asset Classes → PPF & EPF**, route `/provident-fund`, page title **Provident Fund**) tracks Public Provident Fund and Employees' Provident Fund money in two ways. **Manual entries** — contributions, interest credits, withdrawals and opening balances — are ordinary transactions that build the PPF and EPF holdings on the page. **Auto-fetch accounts** link an EPFO UAN or a PPF account at one of seven banks so the passbook can be pulled from the portal (server-side, with you typing the captcha and OTP), uploaded as a PDF, or sent by the EveryPaisa browser extension. The old addresses `/ppf` and `/epf` open this page. Nothing here is plan-gated.

### Provident Fund page and holdings <!-- F-PF-001 -->
**What it does:** Shows your PPF and EPF holdings across all portfolios with a summary strip (**Invested**, **Current value**, **Unrealised P&L**), the holdings, a **Transactions** table of every PPF and EPF entry (date, name, type, quantity, price, amount) with edit and delete, and below it the **Auto-fetch accounts (EPFO portal)** section (F-PF-005).

**Why it exists:** Page description: "Track your PPF and EPF balances, contributions, and interest".

**Where to find it:** **Asset Classes → PPF & EPF** (route `/provident-fund`; `/ppf` and `/epf` redirect here).

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO; R-MANAGER for the managed person. Family view does not add other members' entries.

**Steps**
1. Open **Asset Classes → PPF & EPF**. With nothing recorded, the empty state "No provident fund yet" offers **Add first entry**.
2. Click **Add** and choose **PPF entry** (F-PF-003) or **EPF entry** (F-PF-002).
3. Click the pencil on a transaction to edit it in its form; click the bin, then **Yes** at "Sure?" to delete it (**No** cancels).
4. Use the download button for a holdings report (D-PF-002).

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Add** → **PPF entry** / **EPF entry** | Menu button | Opens the PPF or EPF form | Never |
| Download report button | Button | Holdings report for PPF and EPF (D-PF-002) | Never |
| Transaction edit / delete | Buttons | Edit in the matching form; delete after "Sure?" | — |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable — see F-PF-002 and F-PF-003.

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** Nothing changes by viewing.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Failed to delete" | Server error | Try again |
| Balance fetched from EPFO doesn't show in the holdings | Auto-fetched passbook rows are stored separately and don't create holdings (see F-PF-006) | Add an **Opening / current balance** entry manually |

**Limitations:** Holdings come only from manual entries; auto-fetched or uploaded passbooks don't change them. The transactions table shows up to 200 entries per asset class. PPF and EPF have no market price, so **Current value** comes from the shared asset-page rules (D-PF-001).

**How it works:** The page is the shared asset-class page configured with asset classes PPF and EPF and two entry forms; it reads each portfolio's holdings and `GET /api/transactions?assetClass=PPF|EPF` (200 per class). Holdings group entries by account number (UAN / PPF account number) when given, otherwise by the employer or bank name typed.

**Related features:** F-PF-002, F-PF-003, F-PF-005, D-PF-001, D-PF-002.

### Add or edit an EPF entry <!-- F-PF-002 -->
**What it does:** The **Add EPF Entry** dialog records one EPF entry: employer, optional UAN, entry type (**Contribution (monthly)**, **Annual interest credit**, **Withdrawal / settlement**, **Opening / current balance**), date, amount, optional interest rate and notes. A second tab, **Auto-fetch (UAN)**, links the UAN for auto-fetch instead (F-PF-004).

**Why it exists:** Inferred from behavior: lets you keep an EPF balance without portal access.

3. Pick the **Entry Type**; the amount label changes (**Total Contribution (₹)**, **Interest Credited (₹)**, **Amount Withdrawn (₹)**, **Current Balance (₹)**) with a hint.
4. For **Annual interest credit**, optionally fill **Interest Rate Applied (% p.a.)**.
5. Click **Add EPF entry**. The toast "EPF entry added" appears.
6. When editing, **Delete** asks "Sure?" — **Yes, delete** removes it (toast "EPF entry deleted").

**Settings and toggles here:** S-PF-001 **Entry Type (EPF)**.

**Results:** A transaction of class EPF is saved (quantity 1, price = amount). Contributions and opening balances add to the EPF holding; withdrawals reduce it; interest credits are recorded as income but do not add to the holding.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Failed to save" / "Failed to delete" (or the server message) | Server rejected the entry | Read the message |

**How it works:** `POST /api/transactions` (or `PATCH` / `DELETE /api/transactions/:id`) with asset class `EPF`, transaction type `DEPOSIT`, `INTEREST_RECEIVED`, `WITHDRAWAL` or `OPENING_BALANCE`, the UAN stored in the ISIN field. Holdings treat DEPOSIT and OPENING_BALANCE as additions and WITHDRAWAL as a reduction; INTEREST_RECEIVED is not an addition.

### Refresh from the EPFO portal <!-- F-PF-006 -->
**What it does:** **Refresh Provident Fund** asks for the **UAN** and **Password**, starts a server-side fetch of the passbook, and relays the portal's captcha image and OTP to you to type in. When done it says "Imported N new entries."

**Why it exists:** To pull the passbook without downloading it yourself. Inferred from behavior.

**Where to find it:** **Asset Classes → PPF & EPF → Auto-fetch accounts → Refresh** (or **Refresh now**).

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO; R-MANAGER for the managed person.

**Steps**
1. Click **Refresh**. Enter **UAN** (a hint appears if it isn't 12 digits: "Your UAN is 12 digits — not an email address. It is on your payslip.") and **Password**.
2. Optionally tick **Save credentials (encrypted)**.
3. Click **Start**. Progress shows the current step.
4. When asked, type the characters from the captcha image and click **Submit CAPTCHA**; then the OTP ("OTP sent via <channel>.") and **Submit OTP**.
5. On success: "Imported N new entries." — click **Close**. On failure the message shows with **Try again**.
6. Don't know the password? Click **Don't know your EPFO password?** (F-PF-008).

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Save credentials (encrypted)** | Checkbox | Stores the UAN and password encrypted on the account | — |
| **Start** | Button | Starts the fetch | Disabled until UAN and password are filled |
| **Submit CAPTCHA** / **Submit OTP** | Buttons | Send your answer | Disabled with an empty box |
| **Try again** | Button | Back to the credentials | On error |
| **Don't know your EPFO password?** | Link | Opens the reset dialog | — |

**Fields and rules**
| Field | Type | Required | Format / limits | Default | Error shown (exact) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **UAN** | Text | Yes | Hint only for non-12-digit input | Empty | — |
| **Password** | Password | Yes | — | Empty | — |
| Captcha / OTP | Text | Yes | 1–64 characters | Empty | "Invalid body" (server) |

**Settings and toggles here:** S-PF-003 **Save credentials (encrypted)**.

**Results:** Passbook rows are stored as confirmed passbook events against the account, and the account's last refresh date and source are set. These events appear in the provident-fund statement report (D-PF-004) but do not create PPF/EPF transactions or holdings, and do not set the account balance.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Could not start this right now. Please try again in a minute." | The job queue is unavailable | Wait and retry |
| "Connection to server lost" | The live connection dropped | Try again |
| "PF account not found" | The account is gone | Reload |

**Limitations:** The fetched balance and entries don't reach the page's holdings or the account's balance field (see DOCUMENTATION_GAPS.md). Saved credentials are not reused by the dialog — it always asks again — and there is no button to delete saved credentials. The dialog labels the login **UAN** even for PPF bank accounts. Each attempt runs once (no automatic retry) and is stopped after 10 minutes.

**How it works:** `POST /api/epfppf/sessions` creates a fetch session and queues a job on the `pf-headless-fetch` queue (Redis); the worker runs the institution's scraper and streams `status`, `captcha_required`, `otp_required`, `completed` and `failed` events to `GET /api/epfppf/sessions/:id/events`; answers go to `…/captcha` and `…/otp`. Rows become CanonicalEvents with status CONFIRMED (idempotent by source hash); the holding recompute runs only for accounts with a portfolio, and replays transactions only.

**Related features:** F-PF-005, F-PF-007, F-PF-008, D-PF-004.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/pf/PfRefreshDialog.tsx:32`, `apps/web/src/pages/pf/PfRefreshDialog.tsx:154`, `apps/web/src/pages/pf/PfRefreshDialog.tsx:179`, `packages/api/src/controllers/pf.controller.ts:138`, `packages/api/src/controllers/pf.controller.ts:30`, `packages/api/src/jobs/pfFetchWorker.ts:47`, `packages/api/src/jobs/pfFetchWorker.ts:102`, `packages/api/src/ingestion/projection.ts:559`

| Scanned PDF message (code SCANNED_PDF) | The PDF is an image | Download a text PDF from EPFO |
| "PDF parse failed: …" or another parse message | Not an EPFO passbook layout | Use the EPFO passbook PDF |

**Limitations:** The parser reads the EPFO passbook layout even when the account is a PPF account.

**How it works:** `POST /api/epfppf/accounts/:id/passbook` (multipart, in memory, 10 MB). The PDF is unlocked with saved, derived or typed passwords, tokenised, parsed by the EPFO passbook parser and stored as CONFIRMED CanonicalEvents (adapter `pf.epfo.manual.v1`).

**Related features:** F-PF-006, D-PF-004.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/pf/PfManualUploadDialog.tsx:71`, `packages/api/src/controllers/pf.controller.ts:71`, `packages/api/src/controllers/pf.controller.ts:360`, `packages/api/src/controllers/pf.controller.ts:426`, `packages/api/src/controllers/pf.controller.ts:497`

### Reset the EPFO password <!-- F-PF-008 -->
**What it does:** **Reset your EPFO password** collects the UAN, the mobile number registered with EPFO and a new password that meets EPFO's rules, and is meant to run the portal's reset with captcha and OTP relayed to you.

**Why it exists:** "Most people have never used their EPFO password … Without a way out, this dialog is a dead end for them." (code comment)

**Where to find it:** **Refresh Provident Fund → Don't know your EPFO password?**

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO.

**Steps**
1. Fill **UAN**, **Mobile registered with EPFO** and **New password**; hints show what is missing ("Your UAN is 12 digits — it is on your payslip.", "Enter the 10-digit number EPFO has on file. The code can only go there.", "EPFO needs 7 to 20 characters, a letter, a digit, a special character.").
2. Click **Send code**. The dialog shows "Contacting EPFO…".

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Send code** | Button | Starts the reset | Disabled until all three fields are valid |
| **Submit** / **Verify** | Buttons | Captcha / OTP answers | — |
| **Back to refresh** / **Close** / **Try again** | Buttons | Finish or retry | Per outcome |

**Fields and rules**
| Field | Type | Required | Format / limits | Default | Error shown (exact) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **UAN** | Text | Yes | 12 digits (spaces and dashes ignored) | Empty | hint above |
| **Mobile registered with EPFO** | Text | Yes | 10 digits starting 6–9; +91 stripped | Empty | hint above |
| **New password** | Password | Yes | 7–20 characters with a letter, a digit and a special character | Empty | hint above |

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** The new password is never stored. At most 3 resets are allowed per day ("Too many password reset attempts today. Try again tomorrow.").

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Stays on "Contacting EPFO…" | The web app starts the reset in browser-extension mode, and nothing in this repository runs extension-mode resets (see Limitations) | Reset the password on the EPFO portal directly |

**Limitations:** Defect: the dialog doesn't send a source, so the server defaults to the extension and queues nothing; no extension endpoint receives the session, so the reset never starts. See DOCUMENTATION_GAPS.md.

**How it works:** `POST /api/epfppf/password-reset` (`uan`, `mobile`, `newPassword`, `source` default `EXTENSION`); only `SERVER_HEADLESS` enqueues a `password-reset` job. Events would arrive on the same session stream as a refresh (`password_reset`, `lookup_failed`, `failed`).

**Related features:** F-PF-006, F-PF-009.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/pf/PfPasswordResetDialog.tsx:46`, `apps/web/src/pages/pf/PfPasswordResetDialog.tsx:77`, `packages/api/src/controllers/pf.controller.ts:225`, `packages/api/src/controllers/pf.controller.ts:244`, `packages/api/src/services/pf/uanLookup.service.ts:42`

### Browser extension pairing <!-- F-PF-009 -->
**What it does:** The **Browser Extension** page pairs the EveryPaisa browser extension with your account using an 8-character code valid for 5 minutes, and lists **Connected extensions** with **Disconnect**.

**Why it exists:** "Connect the EveryPaisa browser extension to auto-fetch your EPF and PPF data." (page text)

**Where to find it:** **Asset Classes → PPF & EPF → Browser extension** (route `/provident-fund/extension`).

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO.

**Steps**
1. Install the extension (the page says "from the Chrome Web Store").
2. Click **Generate pairing code**. The code and a countdown ("Expires in m:ss") appear with "Waiting for extension…".
3. In the extension popup, click **Pair** and enter the code. The page shows "Extension connected successfully!" and the toast "Extension connected!".
4. If the code expires: "Code expired. Generate a new one." → **Generate new code**.
5. Click **Disconnect** on a connected extension to revoke it (toast "Extension disconnected").

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Generate pairing code** / **Generate new code** | Button | Creates a code | Disabled while generating |
| **Disconnect** | Button | Revokes the pairing | "Disconnecting…" while working |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable.

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** A paired extension gets a long-lived token it uses to send scraped passbooks to your account; disconnecting revokes it.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Failed to generate pairing code" / "Failed to revoke" | Server error | Try again |

**Limitations:** The extension itself is not in this repository. The page polls every 3 seconds only while a code is valid.

**How it works:** `POST /api/epfppf/extension/pair-init`, `GET …/extension/pairings`, `DELETE …/extension/pairings/:id`. The extension calls `POST …/extension/pair-complete` (no sign-in; the code is the credential), then `GET …/extension/me`, `POST …/extension/raw-payload` and `POST …/extension/revoke` with its bearer token.

**Related features:** F-PF-006, F-PF-011, D-PF-005.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/pf/PfExtensionPairPage.tsx:59`, `apps/web/src/pages/pf/PfExtensionPairPage.tsx:234`, `apps/web/src/pages/pf/PfExtensionPairPage.tsx:218`, `packages/api/src/routes/pf.routes.ts:52`, `packages/api/src/routes/pf.routes.ts:97`

### PF refresh-due alerts <!-- F-PF-010 -->
**What it does:** Once a day, creates a "Refresh EPF account" / "Refresh PPF account" alert for each active linked account not refreshed for 30 days or more (or never), at most one unread per account and not again within 7 days, skipping snoozed accounts.

**Why it exists:** Code comment: "emits PF_REFRESH_DUE alerts so the user is prompted to re-fetch their balance."

**Where to find it:** **Alerts** (D-PF-006) and the yellow banner on the page (F-PF-005).

**Who can use it:** All users with linked accounts.

**Steps:** Not applicable — automatic.

**Controls:** None.

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable.

**Settings and toggles here:** S-PF-004 **Snooze 30d** suppresses it.

**Results:** Alert text: "<holder> (···1234) last refreshed N days ago — tap to refresh and keep data current." or "… has never been refreshed."

**Errors and troubleshooting:** None.

**Limitations:** The job is scheduled at 03:30 IST although its comments say 09:00 IST (see DOCUMENTATION_GAPS.md).

**How it works:** node-cron `30 3 * * *` with time zone Asia/Kolkata, running as system (all users); disabled by `ENABLE_PF_NUDGE_CRON=false`.

**Related features:** F-PF-005.

**Sources:** `packages/api/src/jobs/pfNudgeJob.ts:44`, `packages/api/src/services/pf/pfNudges.service.ts:20`, `packages/api/src/services/pf/pfNudges.service.ts:21`, `packages/api/src/services/pf/pfNudges.service.ts:58`

### What this area doesn't do

- You can't delete or unlink a linked auto-fetch account, or remove saved portal credentials.
- Fetched or uploaded passbooks don't update the PF holdings or the balance shown on the account.
- Interest rates are not looked up; the hints are fixed text.
- There is no PPF maturity or extension reminder.

## Forex

The **Forex** page (sidebar **Asset Classes → Forex**, route `/forex`) covers money held or moved in foreign currencies: live reference rates, foreign-currency cash balances, currency-pair trading positions with their speculative P&L, foreign shares, and outward remittances under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) with tax collected at source (TCS). Forex is an optional asset class: it appears in the sidebar only after you add it with **Add asset class** (D-FX-001). Nothing here is plan-gated.

### Live FX rates <!-- F-FX-001 -->
**What it does:** The **Live FX rates** panel shows the latest stored rate for each INR pair (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, AED, SGD, AUD, CAD, CHF, HKD, CNY → INR) and six cross pairs (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, AUD/USD, USD/CAD, USD/CHF), each with its source badge — **RBI**, **FRANKFURTER**, **YAHOO** or **DERIVED**. **Refresh** fetches new rates from the sources now.

**Why it exists:** Page description: "Live RBI reference rates with Yahoo fallback."

**Where to find it:** **Asset Classes → Forex**, top of the page.

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO; R-MANAGER.

**Steps**
1. Open **Forex**. Rates load; "Updating…" shows during each 30-second refresh.
2. Click **Refresh** to fetch from the sources. The toast "Refreshed N rates" appears.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Refresh** | Button | Runs a rate sync now | Disabled while running |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable.

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** New rates are stored for today and used everywhere (cash INR equivalents, LRS, foreign holdings).

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "No rates yet — hit refresh." | No rates stored yet | Click **Refresh** |
| "FX refresh failed" | All sources failed | Try later; the hourly job retries |

**Limitations:** INR rates show 4 decimals, cross rates 6. Rates fetched from exchangerate-api are labelled **FRANKFURTER**. Any signed-in user's **Refresh** runs the same app-wide sync.

**How it works:** `GET /api/forex/ticker` reads the latest stored rate per pair; the page re-reads every 30 seconds. `POST /api/forex/ticker/refresh` runs `syncFxRates`: RBI's reference page for USD/EUR/GBP/JPY, then exchangerate-api, then Frankfurter, then Yahoo for anything missing and the cross pairs, then derived rates. The same sync runs hourly (`0 * * * *`, IST) under `ENABLE_PRICE_CRONS`, and at startup if rates are older than 6 hours.

**Related features:** F-FX-002, F-FX-003, D-FX-002.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/forex/ForexRateTicker.tsx:22`, `apps/web/src/pages/forex/ForexRateTicker.tsx:29`, `apps/web/src/pages/forex/ForexRateTicker.tsx:59`, `packages/api/src/priceFeeds/fx.service.ts:22`, `packages/api/src/priceFeeds/fx.service.ts:42`, `packages/api/src/priceFeeds/fx.service.ts:212`, `packages/api/src/priceFeeds/fx.service.ts:233`, `packages/api/src/controllers/forex.controller.ts:171`, `packages/api/src/jobs/priceJobs.ts:354`, `packages/api/src/jobs/startupSync.ts:94`

### Forex pair P&L by financial year <!-- F-FX-004 -->
**What it does:** The **Speculative business income (FOREX_PAIR P&L)** table shows, per portfolio, pair and financial year, buy and sell quantity, realised P&L and open position, with "Net realised across all pairs".

**Why it exists:** FX pair trades are speculative business income and skip the capital-gains engine (code comment).

**Where to find it:** **Asset Classes → Forex → FX pairs**, below the positions.

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO; R-MANAGER.

**Steps:** Not applicable — view only.

**Controls:** None.

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable.

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** None.

**Errors and troubleshooting:** "No realised P&L yet. Record matching BUY + SELL transactions on a pair to see speculative business income aggregated by FY."

**Limitations:** Defect: buys and sells are grouped by the financial year of each trade, so a position bought in one year and sold in the next shows no realised P&L. Realised P&L uses average buy and sell prices over the matched quantity, not FIFO lots as the comment says.

**How it works:** `GET /api/forex/pairs/:portfolioId/pnl` per portfolio (refused with 403 for someone else's portfolio). Realised = (average sell − average buy) × min(buy qty, sell qty).

**Related features:** F-FX-003.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/forex/ForexPairsTab.tsx:67`, `packages/api/src/services/forex/forex.service.ts:412`, `packages/api/src/services/forex/forex.service.ts:420`, `packages/api/src/services/forex/forex.service.ts:446`, `packages/api/src/controllers/forex.controller.ts:177`

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** None.

**Errors and troubleshooting:** None.

**Limitations:** Usage converts the year's INR total to USD at today's USD/INR rate (₹83 if none is stored), not the rate on each remittance date, so the percentage moves with the rupee. The TCS figures are informational; the 20% above ₹7 lakh rule is fixed in code.

### What this area doesn't do

- You can't edit a remittance or add a TCS credit from the app.
- Foreign cash balances are not counted in holdings, the dashboard or net worth (no other service reads them).
- There are no rate alerts or historical rate charts.

## Goals

The **Goals** page (sidebar **Planning → Goals**, route `/goals`, page title **Financial goals**) tracks targets such as retirement, a child's education or a FIRE corpus. Each goal has a target amount and date; its progress is a starting amount plus the current value of the portfolios you link to it, and it shows the yearly return you would need to get there. Goals are a **Plus** feature.

### Goals list and progress <!-- F-GOAL-001 -->
**What it does:** Lists your goals as cards in three sections — **Active**, **Achieved** and **Paused / abandoned** — each with category and priority badges, a progress bar and percentage, **Current**, **Target**, **Remaining**, **Target date**, years left ("N.Ny left"), the yearly return needed ("Need N.N% CAGR"), an **Off-track** flag when the needed return exceeds your expected return, and the linked portfolios.

**Why it exists:** Page description: "Track progress against retirement, child education, FIRE corpus, and custom targets."

**Where to find it:** **Planning → Goals** (route `/goals`).

**Who can use it:** R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO (server-enforced: GOAL_PROJECTIONS needs Plus). R-FREE sees the page blurred behind "Goal Planning is locked — Upgrade to Plus to unlock Goal Planning." with **View plans**. R-MANAGER: the manager's plan decides; goals shown are the managed person's.

**Steps**
1. Open **Planning → Goals**. With no goals: "No goals yet" and **Create first goal**.
2. Read each card. Click **Edit** to change a goal (F-GOAL-002) or the bin to delete it (F-GOAL-003).

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **New goal** / **Create first goal** | Button | Opens **Create goal** | — |
| **Edit** | Button | Opens **Edit goal** | — |
| Bin (title "Delete") | Button | Deletes after confirmation | — |
| **View plans** | Link | Opens Pricing | Shown only when locked |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable — view only.

**Settings and toggles here:** S-GOAL-001 to S-GOAL-006 are set in the goal form.

**Results:** Nothing changes by viewing.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Locked card | Your plan is Free | Upgrade on Pricing |
| "Need …% CAGR" missing | Current value is 0, or the target date has passed | Link a portfolio or add an initial amount |

**Limitations:** **Inflation rate** has no visible effect: the needed return is computed against the target as entered, not the inflation-adjusted target, which is computed but not shown (see DOCUMENTATION_GAPS.md). When current value already exceeds the target, the needed return shows as a negative percentage. Progress is capped at 100%.

**How it works:** `GET /api/goals` (Plus-gated) returns each goal with computed fields. Current value = initial amount + the value of holdings in linked portfolios you own (current value, or cost when no price); an **Emergency fund** goal counts only cash, fixed and recurring deposits and post-office savings, RD and TD. Remaining = max(0, target − current). Years left = days to target date ÷ 365.25. Needed return = (target ÷ current)^(1 ÷ years) − 1, only when current > 0 and the date is in the future. **Off-track** when needed return > expected return. Sorted by status, then nearest target date.

**Related features:** F-GOAL-002, F-GOAL-003, D-GOAL-001, D-GOAL-002.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/goals/GoalsPage.tsx:43`, `apps/web/src/pages/goals/GoalsPage.tsx:87`, `apps/web/src/pages/goals/GoalsPage.tsx:221`, `apps/web/src/pages/goals/GoalsPage.tsx:294`, `apps/web/src/components/common/LockedFeature.tsx:59`, `packages/api/src/routes/goals.routes.ts:9`, `packages/api/src/services/goals/goals.service.ts:173`, `packages/api/src/services/goals/goals.service.ts:215`, `packages/api/src/services/goals/goalMath.ts:38`, `packages/api/src/services/goals/goalMath.ts:53`

## Cash Activity

The **Cash Activity** page (sidebar **Overview → Cash Activity**, route `/cashflows`) shows a 12-month forecast of scheduled money in and out, and the list of cash-flow entries — money-in and money-out records created from approved bank alerts, rent, and split-expense settlements. Not plan-gated.

### Scheduled cashflow forecast <!-- F-CASH-001 -->
**What it does:** The **Scheduled cashflow** card ("Forecast · next 12 months") shows **Expected inflows**, **Expected outflows** and **Net**, a monthly bar chart of inflows and outflows, "Negative cashflow month ahead" when any month nets below zero, and the next 6 **Upcoming events** (Loan EMI, Rent due, Premium, FD matures, RD matures).

**Why it exists:** Code comment: aggregates the next N months of scheduled inflows and outflows.

**Where to find it:** **Overview → Cash Activity**, top card.

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO; R-MANAGER for the managed person.

**Steps:** Not applicable — view only.

**Controls:** Chart tooltip on hover.

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable.

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** None.

**Errors and troubleshooting:** None shown; the card is hidden if loading fails.

**Limitations:** Each insurance policy contributes only its next premium, so a monthly or quarterly premium appears once in 12 months. FD and RD maturities show the amount invested, not the maturity value. Rent shows the full expected amount even for a partly paid month. The chart can show a 13th month for an event exactly 12 months away.

**How it works:** `GET /api/cashflows/forecast?horizonMonths=12` (1–36 accepted). Events from today to today + 12 months: unpaid EMIs from each active loan's schedule; rent receipts expected, overdue or partial; the stored next premium due of active policies; FD/RD buy transactions maturing in range. Totals use decimal arithmetic.

**Related features:** F-CASH-002, D-CASH-002.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/cashflows/CashflowForecastSection.tsx:25`, `apps/web/src/pages/cashflows/CashflowForecastSection.tsx:62`, `packages/api/src/services/analytics/cashflowForecast.service.ts:67`, `packages/api/src/services/analytics/cashflowForecast.service.ts:136`, `packages/api/src/services/analytics/cashflowForecast.service.ts:170`, `packages/api/src/controllers/cashflows.controller.ts:9`

The whole module needs the **Pro/Advisor** plan.

### Add or delete an account <!-- F-ACCT-003 -->
**What it does:** **Add Account** creates an account with code, type, name, parent and opening balance. Delete removes an account that has no voucher entries and no sub-accounts.

**Why it exists:** To shape the chart to your books. Inferred from behavior.

**Where to find it:** **Tools → Accounting → Chart of Accounts → Add account**, or a row's **+** / bin.

**Who can use it:** R-PRO; R-MANAGER per the manager's plan.

2. Fill **Code** (placeholder "e.g. 1001"), **Type**, **Name**, **Parent Account** (**None (top-level)** or an account), **Opening Balance (₹)**.

4. To delete: click the bin and confirm `Delete account "<name>"?`. The toast "Account deleted" appears.

| Field | Type | Required | Format / limits | Default | Error shown (exact) |

### New voucher <!-- F-ACCT-005 -->
**What it does:** **New Voucher** records a voucher with type, number (suggested automatically), date, narration and one or more lines, each a debit account, a credit account, an amount and an optional narration, with a running **Total**.

**Why it exists:** To post entries the automatic generation doesn't cover. Inferred from behavior.

**Where to find it:** **Tools → Accounting → Vouchers → New Voucher**.

**Who can use it:** R-PRO; R-MANAGER per the manager's plan.

**Steps**
1. Click **New Voucher**. Type **JOURNAL**, today's date and a suggested number (for example "JO0001") fill in.
2. Change **Type** if needed; the suggested number follows the type's two-letter prefix.
3. For each line pick **Debit Account** and **Credit Account** and type **Amount (₹)**; click **Add row** for more lines, the bin (aria "Remove row") to drop one.
4. Click **Save Voucher**. The toast "Voucher created" appears.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Add row** | Button | Adds a line | — |
| Bin (aria "Remove row") | Button | Removes a line | Hidden with one line |
| **Save Voucher** | Button | Saves; "Saving…" | Disabled until every line has both accounts and an amount, and while saving |
| **Cancel** | Button | Closes | — |

**Fields and rules**
| Field | Type | Required | Format / limits | Default | Error shown (exact) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Type** | Select (6) | Yes | — | JOURNAL | — |
| **Voucher No.** | Text | Yes | 1–50; unique per type | Suggested | Server: "Voucher number <no> already exists for type <type>" (shown as a generic error) |
| **Date** | Date | Yes | YYYY-MM-DD | Today | — |
| **Narration** | Text | No | Up to 500 | Empty | — |
| **Debit Account** / **Credit Account** | Select | Yes | Your accounts | "Select…" | Server: "One or more account IDs not found" |
| **Amount (₹)** | Number | Yes | Positive decimal | Empty | — |

**Settings and toggles here:** S-ACCT-004 **Voucher type**.

**Results:** The voucher is saved and appears in the list, ledger and statements.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Generic request error when saving a second voucher | The suggested number isn't refreshed after a save (and a typed number is kept), so it repeats (defect) | Type a new number, or reload the page |

**Limitations:** The dialog keeps the previous voucher's lines after saving. With only generated ("AUTO-…") vouchers of a type, the suggested number is built from the digits inside the generated voucher's id, giving a very long number (defect). After number 9999 the suggestion stops increasing because numbers are compared as text.

**How it works:** `GET /api/accounting/vouchers/next-no?type=` returns the type's first two letters + the last number + 1, padded to 4 digits (cached for 30 seconds in the browser). `POST /api/accounting/vouchers` checks every account is yours and the number is unused for the type. Each line is its own debit/credit pair, so a voucher always balances.

### Generate vouchers from activity <!-- F-ACCT-007 -->
**What it does:** **Generate from activity** creates, updates or removes "auto" vouchers so the books match your activity: buys, SIPs and deposits (PURCHASE: investment Dr, bank Cr), dividend reinvestment and opening balances (JOURNAL), sales and redemptions (SALES, splitting short-term, long-term and intraday gains or losses), dividends and interest (RECEIPT), realised F&O profit or loss, loan disbursements and loan payments (principal, interest, processing fees), rent received and insurance premiums. The same projection runs automatically before the ledger and every statement is shown.

**Why it exists:** Button tooltip: "Auto-create vouchers from BUY/SELL transactions, dividends, rent receipts, loan EMIs and premium payments".

**Where to find it:** **Tools → Accounting → Vouchers → Generate from activity**.

**Who can use it:** R-PRO; R-MANAGER per the manager's plan.

**Steps**
1. Click **Generate from activity** ("Generating…").
2. Read the toast: "Created N voucher(s) from existing activity" or "No new vouchers — every existing transaction is already projected".

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Generate from activity** | Button | Runs the projection | Disabled while running |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable.

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** Auto vouchers numbered `AUTO-<kind>-<id>` are created, rewritten when their source changed, and deleted when their source is gone.

**Errors and troubleshooting:** Per-voucher failures are counted and skipped.

**Limitations:** The toast reports only newly created vouchers; updates and removals are not mentioned. Investment accounts by asset class: equity/ETF → Equity Holdings; mutual funds → Mutual Fund Holdings; FD/RD → Fixed Deposits; bonds → Bonds & Debentures; gold → Gold Holdings; F&O, insurance, ULIP and cash are not booked as investments; others → Other Investments. All money moves through **Bank Accounts** (1001).

**How it works:** `POST /api/accounting/generate-from-activity`; ledger, trial balance, P&L and balance sheet requests call the same projection first and log (not show) a failure.

**Related features:** F-ACCT-004, F-ACCT-009 to F-ACCT-012, D-ACCT-001.

### Ledger <!-- F-ACCT-009 -->
**What it does:** Shows one account's postings in a date range: **Opening** and **Closing** balances and a table of **Date**, **Voucher**, **Narration**, **Debit**, **Credit** and running **Balance**.

**Why it exists:** To check an account's movement. Inferred from behavior.

**Where to find it:** **Tools → Accounting → Ledger**.

| **Account** | Select | Chooses the account | — |
| **From** / **To** | Dates | Range | — |

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** None (the books are re-projected first — F-ACCT-007).

## Reports

The **Reports** page (sidebar **Tools → Reports**, route `/reports`, page title "Reports — Capital gains, income, XIRR and historical valuation") is where you read and download figures computed from your transactions: on-screen tables for capital gains, income, XIRR and valuation history, four statements, a catalog of 42 print-style "Tax & MIS" downloads, and the review queue for documents found in your Gmail. A data-checks banner above the tabs says whether the figures can be trusted. The same reporting engine also powers the **Download** button that appears on many other pages (F-REPORT-016), and a nightly job keeps stored figures in step with your transactions (F-REPORT-017).

### Reports page filters and tabs <!-- F-REPORT-001 -->
**What it does:** Gives the page its common filter card — **Portfolio**, **Report for** (only when you can report on someone else), **Financial Year** (only on tabs that need one) — and a row of 12 tabs: **Summary**, **Tax & MIS downloads**, **Statements**, **Unrealised P&L**, **Intraday**, **STCG**, **LTCG**, **Schedule 112A**, **Income**, **XIRR**, **Historical**, **Inbox imports**. Only the open tab's data is fetched.

**Why it exists:** One place for every report, with one set of filters, so the same portfolio and year apply as you move between tabs. The default of **All portfolios** exists so "a brand-new user (or one whose first portfolio happens to be empty) sees real numbers, not zeros" (code comment).

**Where to find it:** **Tools → Reports** (route `/reports`). A tab can be opened directly with `/reports?tab=<key>` (for example `/reports?tab=inbox-imports`); an unknown key opens **Summary**.

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO (all tabs open; some downloads are plan-gated, see F-REPORT-013 and F-REPORT-014). R-MANAGER sees the managed person's data. R-VISITOR is sent to sign in.

**Steps**
1. Open **Tools → Reports**. The **Summary** tab opens with **All portfolios** selected.
2. Pick a portfolio in **Portfolio** if you want one book only. The open tab reloads for that portfolio.
3. On **Intraday**, **STCG**, **LTCG**, **Schedule 112A** or **Income**, choose a year in **Financial Year**. The table reloads.
4. Click any tab to switch report. The filters stay as you set them.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Portfolio** | Select | **All portfolios** or one of your portfolios (S-REPORT-001) | Never hidden |
| **Report for** | Select | Whose figures the downloads on this page cover (S-REPORT-002) | Hidden when you are not viewing a family, or your family view is capped, or the family has no other active member |
| **Financial Year** | Select | Year for FY-based tabs (S-REPORT-003) | Shown only on Intraday, STCG, LTCG, Schedule 112A, Income |
| **Excel**, **PDF** | Buttons | Download the open tab (F-REPORT-010) | Shown only on Unrealised P&L, Intraday, STCG, LTCG, Schedule 112A, Income |
| Tab buttons (12) | Tabs | Switch report | Never |

**Fields and rules**
| Field | Type | Required | Format / limits | Default | Error shown (exact) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portfolio | Select | Yes | `all` or a portfolio id | **All portfolios** | "Forbidden" if the portfolio is not yours (see Limitations) |
| Financial Year | Select | Yes on FY tabs | Current FY and the 7 before it, as "2026-27" | Current Indian FY (April–March, computed in UTC) | "Invalid financial year "…" — expected consecutive years like 2025-26" (server) |

**Settings and toggles here:** S-REPORT-001 **Portfolio** — one book or all; S-REPORT-002 **Report for** — Me / Whole family / one member, downloads only; S-REPORT-003 **Financial Year** — the year for FY-based tabs. None of them is saved; all reset when you leave the page.

**Results:** Nothing is changed in your data; the tables and downloads follow the chosen filters.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| A tab stays empty with no message | The request failed (for example "Forbidden" on a portfolio you do not own) and the page shows nothing on error | Choose **All portfolios** or one of your own portfolios |
| "Select a portfolio to view reports." | No portfolio value is set | Pick a value in **Portfolio** |

**Limitations:** The filters are not remembered between visits. In a family view the **Portfolio** list also shows portfolios belonging to other members (the list follows the family view) but every Reports endpoint accepts only portfolios you own, so picking one of theirs leaves the tab empty — use **Report for** downloads instead (see DOCUMENTATION_GAPS.md). On-screen tables are always about you; only downloads follow **Report for**.

**How it works:** The page keeps tab, portfolio (`all` by default) and FY in component state. Each tab is a separate query keyed by portfolio and, where relevant, FY, and enabled only while that tab is open. The server resolves `portfolioId=all` to "every portfolio you own" and otherwise checks the portfolio's owner equals the caller (403 otherwise). FY values are validated as consecutive years. Tab keys accepted from the URL: summary, statements, tax-mis, intraday, stcg, ltcg, schedule-112a, income, unrealised, xirr, historical, inbox-imports.

**Related features:** F-REPORT-002 (search), F-REPORT-003 (data checks), F-REPORT-004 to F-REPORT-015 (tabs), D-REPORT-007 (family view switcher).

### Report search <!-- F-REPORT-002 -->
**What it does:** A search box above the filters ("Search reports… e.g. XIRR, LTCG, holdings statement") that finds any tab, statement or Tax & MIS report by words in its title or description and jumps to it.

**Why it exists:** The page holds 12 tabs, 4 statements and 42 catalog reports; a short blurb per tab makes them "findable by keyword in the search bar below, not just by their tab label" (code comment).

**Where to find it:** **Tools → Reports**, top of the page.

**Who can use it:** Everyone who can open Reports (R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO; R-MANAGER).

**Steps**
1. Type a word, for example "dividend". Up to 8 matches appear, each with the tab it lives on.
2. Use the arrow keys and **Enter**, or click a match. The page switches to that tab; a statement or catalog card is scrolled into view and outlined for about 1.8 seconds.
3. Press **Escape** to close the list.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| Search field | Text | Filters the index as you type | Never |
| Clear search (×) | Button | Empties the field | Hidden while the field is empty |
| Match row | Button | Opens the tab and highlights the card | — |

**Fields and rules**
| Field | Type | Required | Format / limits | Default | Error shown (exact) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Search | Text | No | Case-insensitive substring of title or description; max 8 results | Empty | "No reports match "<text>"" |

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** Only navigation; nothing is saved.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "No reports match "…"" | No title or description contains the text | Try a shorter word (for example "gain") |

**Limitations:** The **Tax & MIS downloads**, **Statements** and **Inbox imports** tabs themselves are not in the index (their cards are). A catalog report found by search is still locked if your plan does not include it.

**How it works:** A static index built from the tab hints, the 4 statement cards and the 42 Tax & MIS report definitions. Matching is in the browser. The dropdown closes 150 ms after the field loses focus so a click can register.

**Related features:** F-REPORT-011, F-REPORT-012, F-REPORT-013, F-REPORT-014.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.tsx:60`, `apps/web/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.tsx:107`, `apps/web/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.tsx:437`, `apps/web/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.tsx:494`, `apps/web/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.tsx:512`

### Data checks banner and Fix now <!-- F-REPORT-003 -->
**What it does:** Above every tab except **Inbox imports**, a line says whether the reports can be trusted: "All data checks passed." with "Data as of: transactions up to … · prices up to …", or a warning/error panel listing what is missing, out of date or inconsistent, with links to fix each item and a **Fix now** button when stored holdings are out of step with transactions.

**Why it exists:** "Reports are computed live from stored data, so they are exactly as good as that data. This sits above every tab and says, in plain words, what is missing, out of date or inconsistent — instead of letting a report print a confident total over a gap" (code comment).

**Where to find it:** **Tools → Reports**, under the filter card.

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO — ungated ("knowing whether your own figures are complete is not a paid feature"). R-MANAGER: checks the managed person's data.

**Steps**
1. Open Reports. "Checking your data…" shows while the checks run.
2. If the panel is amber or red, click **See N issues**. Each issue lists up to 20 examples, then "…and N more".
3. For a sale with no purchase behind it, click **Add purchase** (opens the transaction form pre-filled) or **Review N matching purchase(s) from email** (opens the email review page).
4. If **Fix now** is shown, click it. A toast says "Rebuilt N holding(s) from your transactions" or "Everything already matched your transactions", and every report reloads.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **See N issue(s)** / **Hide details** | Toggle link | Opens/closes the issue list | Hidden when all checks pass |
| **Fix now** | Button | Rebuilds stored holdings and capital gains for the selected portfolio(s) | Shown only when an "out of sync" issue exists; disabled while running |
| **Add purchase** | Link | Opens `/transactions` with the missing purchase pre-filled (asset, quantity, "on or before" date) | Per item, when no matching email purchase is waiting |
| **Review N matching purchase(s) from email** | Link | Opens `/ingestion` | Per item, when matching email events are waiting |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable — no inputs.

**Settings and toggles here:** None (follows S-REPORT-001 **Portfolio**).

**Results:** **Fix now** rewrites the stored holdings and capital-gain rows of the portfolio(s) in scope from the transactions; transactions themselves are never changed.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Data checks could not be run, so these reports have not been verified." | The check request failed | Reload the page; the reports still show |
| "Some figures in these reports are incomplete or wrong." | At least one error-level issue | Open the details and fix the items |
| "These reports may not include your latest data." | Only warning-level issues | Optional: finish imports, review email events |
| "Could not rebuild holdings" (toast) | **Fix now** failed | Try again; the nightly job (F-REPORT-017) also repairs |

**Limitations:** The app never fills in a missing purchase by itself ("a guessed price would put a wrong figure in the tax reports"). Account-wide issues are marked "— across all your portfolios" even when one portfolio is selected.

**How it works:** `GET /api/reports/data-quality?portfolioId=…` (cached in the browser for 60 seconds) runs these checks, in this order: **OVERSOLD** (error) — sales of more units than were bought, booked at zero cost so gains are overstated; **GAINS_NEED_REVIEW** (warning) — gain rows computed with a missing input (for example no CII year); **MISSING_PRICE** (error) — market-priced holdings with no price, valued at cost; **STALE_PRICE** (warning) — price older than 5 days (2 days for crypto); deposits, PF, NPS, insurance, property, bonds and other non-market classes are never stale; **SUSPICIOUS_PRICE** (warning) — latest price moved more than 40% (stocks) or 20% (fund NAVs) from the previous one with no split/bonus/merger within 5 days; **TRADE_PRICE_OFF_MARKET** (warning) — a buy or sell more than 25% away from that day's close/NAV (last 365 days); **HOLDINGS_OUT_OF_SYNC** (error) — stored holding differs from a replay of transactions (tolerance 0.000001 units, ₹0.0001 cost); **STATEMENT_MISMATCH** (error, account) — units on your latest statement differ from transactions; **IMPORTS_NOT_FINISHED**, **EVENTS_AWAITING_REVIEW**, **UNRESOLVED_FAILURES** (warnings, account). **Fix now** calls `POST /api/reports/data-quality/repair`, which re-runs the integrity check with repair for each portfolio in scope and returns the counts. Every downloaded file from Reports also carries "Data as of" and "Data checks" lines from the same checks, or "Could not be run for this file".

**Related features:** F-REPORT-017 (nightly repair), D-REPORT-001 (transaction form), D-REPORT-002 (email review).

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/components/reports/DataQualityBanner.tsx:27`, `apps/web/src/components/reports/DataQualityBanner.tsx:34`, `apps/web/src/components/reports/DataQualityBanner.tsx:55`, `apps/web/src/components/reports/DataQualityBanner.tsx:79`, `apps/web/src/components/reports/DataQualityBanner.tsx:96`, `apps/web/src/components/reports/DataQualityBanner.tsx:143`, `apps/web/src/components/reports/DataQualityBanner.tsx:159`, `packages/api/src/routes/reports.routes.ts:100`, `packages/api/src/controllers/reports.controller.ts:340`, `packages/api/src/controllers/reports.controller.ts:362`, `packages/api/src/services/integrity/reportDataQuality.service.ts:196`, `packages/api/src/services/integrity/reportDataQuality.service.ts:291`, `packages/api/src/services/integrity/reportDataQuality.service.ts:443`, `packages/api/src/services/holdings/priceStaleness.ts:28`, `packages/api/src/services/integrity/storedDataIntegrity.service.ts:38`

### Summary tab <!-- F-REPORT-004 -->
**What it does:** Shows three cards — **Portfolio** (name, currency, number of transactions and holdings), **Unrealised** (Invested, Value, P&L) and **XIRR** (Overall, 1Y, 3Y, 5Y) — and a table **Capital Gains by Financial Year** with columns FY, Intraday, STCG, LTCG, Taxable, newest year first.

**Why it exists:** A one-screen overview of a book before drilling into individual reports. Inferred from behavior.

**Where to find it:** **Tools → Reports → Summary** (default tab).

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO; R-MANAGER (managed person's data).

**Steps**
1. Open Reports. **Summary** shows for **All portfolios** (card title "All portfolios").
2. Choose a portfolio to see that book only.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| None besides the page filters | — | — | — |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable — view only.

**Settings and toggles here:** S-REPORT-001 **Portfolio**.

**Results:** View only.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "No realised gains yet." | No sale has been matched to a purchase | None needed |
| XIRR shows "—" | Less than 90 days of cash-flow history in that window | Wait for more history |

**Limitations:** XIRR windows with less than 90 days of history show "—" rather than a number.

**How it works:** `GET /api/reports/summary`. Unrealised figures come from stored holdings; capital gains are FIFO-matched per FY; XIRR overall and rolling 1/3/5-year values are computed from your dated cash flows and are null when the span is under 90 days. Money is formatted with Indian grouping and banker's rounding to 2 decimals.

### Capital gains tabs: Intraday, STCG, LTCG, Schedule 112A <!-- F-REPORT-006 -->
**What it does:** Four tabs listing realised gains for the chosen FY, one row per FIFO match of a sale to a purchase: Asset, Buy Date, Sell Date, Qty, Buy ₹, Sell ₹, Cost, Proceeds, Gain/Loss, Taxable. The heading shows "<kind> · N rows · Total ₹…", plus "Exemption ₹…" and "Taxable ₹…" where they apply. **Intraday** = bought and sold the same day; **STCG** = short-term; **LTCG** = long-term; **Schedule 112A** = long-term gains on listed equity and equity-oriented funds, with the year's exemption.

**Why it exists:** Gives the per-sale detail a tax return needs, split the way the return asks for it. Inferred from behavior.

**Where to find it:** **Tools → Reports → Intraday / STCG / LTCG / Schedule 112A**.

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO (on-screen and download are ungated); R-MANAGER.

**Steps**
1. Open the tab, choose **Financial Year**.
2. Read the rows; click **Excel** or **PDF** to download.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Financial Year** | Select | Year of the sale | — |
| **Excel**, **PDF** | Buttons | Download | — |

**Fields and rules:** As F-REPORT-001.

**Settings and toggles here:** S-REPORT-001, S-REPORT-002 (download), S-REPORT-003.

**Results:** View only.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "No records for selected FY." | No sale of that kind in the FY | Pick another year |
| Gains look too high | A sale with no purchase is booked at zero cost (data checks: OVERSOLD) | Add the missing purchase |

**Limitations:** Long-term vs short-term follows the app's capital-gains rules table (equity long-term after 12 months; other classes 24 or 36 months depending on the transfer date). The Schedule 112A "Taxable" figure is after the FY exemption (₹1,00,000 from FY 2018-19, ₹1,25,000 from FY 2024-25) and includes grandfathered cost for equity bought on or before 31-Jan-2018.

**How it works:** `GET /api/reports/intraday|stcg|ltcg|schedule-112a?portfolioId&fy`. Rows come from the FIFO capital-gains engine; the Schedule 112A list keeps rows that are LONG_TERM and equity-oriented, and totals apply each FY's own exemption.

**Related features:** F-REPORT-010, F-TAX-004, F-TAX-006.

### Excel / PDF download of the open tab <!-- F-REPORT-010 -->
**What it does:** On **Unrealised P&L**, **Intraday**, **STCG**, **LTCG**, **Schedule 112A** and **Income**, the **Excel** and **PDF** buttons download the same report as a file named `<tab>-<FY><member suffix>.xlsx|pdf`.

**Why it exists:** To hand the figures to a CA or keep them on file. Inferred from behavior.

**Where to find it:** **Tools → Reports**, right side of the filter card, on those six tabs.

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO (ungated); R-FAMOWNER and uncapped members can download for another member or the whole family; R-MANAGER.

**Steps**
1. Open one of the six tabs and set the filters.
2. Optional: choose **Report for**.
3. Click **Excel** or **PDF**. The browser saves the file.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Excel** | Button | `.xlsx` | Hidden on other tabs |
| **PDF** | Button | `.pdf` | Hidden on other tabs |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable — uses the page filters.

**Settings and toggles here:** S-REPORT-001, S-REPORT-002, S-REPORT-003; the file's colours follow the app's light/dark theme (S-REPORT-011).

**Results:** A file is saved on your device. Nothing changes in your data.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| A browser alert showing the raw server error text | The server refused (for example "That member is not part of a family you can see.", or a capped family view: "Your view of this family is limited to certain categories, and reports cannot yet be produced in a limited form. …") | Choose **Me** in **Report for** |

**Limitations:** Errors appear as a plain browser alert containing the raw server response. A file for another member covers all of that member's portfolios, whatever is chosen in **Portfolio**. The file name contains the FY even for **Unrealised P&L**, which is not FY-based.

**How it works:** The browser fetches `GET /api/reports/<tab>?portfolioId&fy&format&theme` with your session token (plus `subject` and `familyId` when **Report for** is not **Me**) and saves the response. The server resolves the subject: Me (default); a member (must be readable in the family you are viewing; capped members are refused); or **Whole family** (one section per member). Each file is stamped with data-check lines.

**Related features:** F-REPORT-001, F-REPORT-003.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.tsx:257`, `apps/web/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.tsx:268`, `apps/web/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.tsx:286`, `apps/web/src/components/reports/useReportSubject.ts:102`, `packages/api/src/services/reports/reportSubjects.ts:94`, `packages/api/src/services/reports/reportSubjects.ts:162`, `packages/api/src/services/reports/reportSubjects.ts:199`

The two FY-based cards show "FY <year>".

**Why it exists:** Sectioned, FY-grouped statements in an industry-standard layout for filing and record keeping (code comment). The household versions of holdings live here.

2. Open **Statements** and click **PDF** or **Excel** on a card. A spinner shows on that card until the file is saved as `everypaisa-<card>-<FY>.pdf|xlsx`.

**Controls**

### Tax & MIS downloads — inputs and free reports <!-- F-REPORT-012 -->
**What it does:** The **Tax & MIS downloads** tab is a catalog of 42 print-style reports (PDF + Excel each; **Export to Tally** is ZIP). Its own input card has **Report for**, **Financial year**, **As-of date**, **From** and **To**; each card shows "Uses: …" with the inputs it takes. Two reports are free on every plan: **Portfolio Holdings Summary** (cross-asset valuation as of today with per-class subtotals) and **Cash Flow Statement** (period inflows vs outflows by category, T-account layout).

**Why it exists:** Mirrors the reports Indian investors and CAs know from desktop portfolio software ("mProfit-style layout"); these are "shaped to look right in print form … and would be visually noisy in-app" (code comment). Holdings summary and cash flow are "the Free-tier 'basic reports' carve-out".

**Where to find it:** **Tools → Reports → Tax & MIS downloads**.

**Who can use it:** Free reports: R-FREE and up. R-MANAGER (managed person's data).

**Steps**

### Inbox imports tab <!-- F-REPORT-015 -->
**What it does:** The review queue for attachments found by a Gmail scan. While a scan runs, a blue line shows "Scanning your inbox — X / Y messages • N documents pending review". Status chips (**Pending review**, **Approved**, **Imported**, **Parse failed**, **All**), sender and document-type filters, and a table (File, From, Date, Type, Confidence, Status, Actions) with **Preview**, **Approve**, **+ Always**, **Reject** per row and bulk **Approve selected** / **Reject selected** / **Clear**.

**Why it exists:** Documents found in email are only imported after you approve them. Inferred from behavior.

**Where to find it:** **Tools → Reports → Inbox imports**; also opened from the dashboard Gmail scan card and after starting a Gmail scan (`/reports?tab=inbox-imports`).

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO with a connected Gmail. R-MANAGER cannot use it: `/api/gmail` is an account route ("Switch back to your own account to do this.").

**Steps**
1. Open the tab. **Pending review** is selected.
2. Optional: filter by sender or document type.
3. Click **Preview** (or the file name) to open the document.
4. Click **Approve** to import it, **+ Always** to approve and auto-approve future documents from that sender, or **Reject**.
5. To act on many: tick rows (only pending ones can be ticked), then **Approve selected** or **Reject selected**. Toast "Approved selected" / "Rejected selected".

**Settings and toggles here:** S-REPORT-008 **Status filter**, S-REPORT-009 **Sender filter**, S-REPORT-010 **Doc type filter** — not saved.

**Results:** Approved documents are queued for import into your transactions; rejected ones are marked rejected. **+ Always** also creates an auto-approve rule for that sender.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Approve failed" / "Reject failed" / "Bulk approve failed" / "Bulk reject failed" (or the server's message) | The action was refused or failed | Retry; see the Gmail inbox page (D-REPORT-003) |
| "No documents in this filter." | Nothing matches | Switch to **All** |

**Limitations:** Shows at most 200 documents per filter. The statuses Rejected, Not financial and Already imported can only be seen under **All**. Single-row **Reject** never adds the sender to a blocklist.

**How it works:** Scan jobs are polled every 5 seconds; while one is PENDING/LISTING/DOWNLOADING/CLASSIFYING, or any listed document is CLASSIFYING/IMPORTING, the list refreshes every 3 seconds. Endpoints are the Gmail scan API owned by B07 (list scans, list docs with `limit=200`, senders, approve, reject, bulk approve with `createAutoApproveRule=false`, bulk reject).

### Nightly stored-data integrity check <!-- F-REPORT-017 -->
**What it does:** Every night at 02:15 IST the app first retries failed imports and emails, then, for every portfolio of every active user, recomputes holdings and capital gains from the transactions alone, compares them with what is stored, and rebuilds anything that drifted. If anything drifted or a portfolio could not be checked, the oldest active administrator gets one in-app alert "Data integrity: stored figures drifted".

**Why it exists:** "The stored rows are a cache of a pure function of the transactions, so when they disagree the cache is wrong by definition and rebuilding it loses nothing." The alert exists because "a drift means some write path skipped its recompute" (code comment).

**Where to find it:** No page. The effect is visible in the Reports data checks banner (F-REPORT-003) — "They are rebuilt automatically every night, or use Fix now" — and, for administrators, in Alerts.

**Who can use it:** Runs automatically for every user's data. R-ADMIN receives the alert.

**Steps:** Not applicable — automatic.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | — | — | — |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable.

**Settings and toggles here:** None for users. Operator switch `ENABLE_DATA_INTEGRITY_CRON` (`false` disables the schedule).

**Results:** Stored holdings and capital-gain rows match your transactions by the morning; a run record is kept (counts, up to 200 per-portfolio detail entries).

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Banner still says "out of sync" in the morning | The check failed for that portfolio | Click **Fix now** (F-REPORT-003) |

**Limitations:** Only portfolios of active users are checked. If no active ADMIN exists, the drift is only logged.

**How it works:** Cron `15 2 * * *` in Asia/Kolkata. Ingestion recovery runs first. Portfolios are listed in system context, each check runs in that user's context (row-level security), with repair on. A second run is skipped while one is in progress. Alert metadata source `data.integrity`.

**Related features:** F-REPORT-003.

**Sources:** `packages/api/src/jobs/dataIntegrityJob.ts:49`, `packages/api/src/jobs/dataIntegrityJob.ts:60`, `packages/api/src/jobs/dataIntegrityJob.ts:66`, `packages/api/src/jobs/dataIntegrityJob.ts:82`, `packages/api/src/jobs/dataIntegrityJob.ts:140`, `packages/api/src/jobs/dataIntegrityJob.ts:158`, `packages/api/src/jobs/dataIntegrityJob.ts:170`, `packages/api/src/jobs/dataIntegrityJob.ts:175`, `packages/api/src/index.ts:240`

**What this area doesn't do**
- You can't schedule reports or have them emailed; every report is downloaded on demand.
- You can't pick a portfolio for the Tax & MIS catalog — it always covers all your portfolios.
- You can't see another member's figures on screen in Reports; only downloads follow **Report for**.
- There is no XIRR or Historical download on this page (use **XIRR / TWR Performance** in the catalog).
- Reports never fill in missing purchases or prices for you.

## Tax Planning

The **Tax Planning** page (sidebar **Planning → Tax Planning**, route `/tax`; page title "Tax Reports — ITR-aligned capital gains, business income and tax-harvesting across all portfolios") estimates the tax on your investment gains for a financial year, lists the gains the way the income-tax return schedules ask for them, shows which holdings could be sold at a loss to cut tax, and lets you enter the 31-Jan-2018 prices used for grandfathering. It always covers all your portfolios.

### Tax summary (estimated tax by section) <!-- F-TAX-002 -->
**What it does:** Three cards — **Total Realised Gain** (FY), **Estimated Tax Liability** ("Excludes surcharge & cess") and **Effective Rate** (Tax / Realised Gain) — and a **Capital Gains Breakdown** table with Section, Description, Gain, Taxable, Rate, Tax for: Sec. 111A (STCG on listed equity, STT paid); Sec. 112A (LTCG on listed equity, "exemption used ₹X of ₹Y"); Sec. 112 (LTCG on other assets, with / without indexation); Slab (STCG on non-equity — debt, bonds, gold, etc.); Sec. 43(5) intraday speculative income; Sec. 115BBH virtual digital assets (only when non-zero); Sec. 43(5) F&O non-speculative (with "· Sec. 44AB audit" when turnover exceeds ₹10 Cr). Below: losses to carry forward, and **Other Income (taxed at slab — outside this estimate)** with Dividends, Interest, Maturity Proceeds.

**Why it exists:** An estimate of the tax on investment gains, aligned to the ITR sections, to plan payments and share with a CA. Inferred from behavior and page title.

**Where to find it:** **Planning → Tax Planning → Summary**.

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO; R-MANAGER.

**Steps**
1. Open the page; **Summary** is the first tab.
2. Read the breakdown; click **Download PDF** (or **CA Tax Report (PDF)**) for the CA report (F-TAX-003).

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Download PDF** | Button | F-TAX-003 | — |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable — view only.

**Settings and toggles here:** S-TAX-001. The slab rate used comes from the tax slab in your most recent risk-profile assessment (D-TAX-001); without it 30% is used and the page says "Slab-rate lines use 30% because your income-tax slab is not on file. Add it in your risk profile for an exact figure."

**Results:** View only.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Effective Rate "—" | Total gain is zero or negative | — |
| Slab lines at 30% | No tax slab on file | Record your slab in the Advisor risk profile |

**Limitations:** Excludes surcharge, cess, deductions (80C/80D) and brought-forward losses. The footnote also says the estimate excludes "any FMV adjustment for pre-31-Jan-2018 equity (grandfathering)", but the Sec. 112A figures do use grandfathered cost (see DOCUMENTATION_GAPS.md). F&O non-speculative profit is computed and shown here on every plan, though the F&O tab itself is Pro/Advisor only.

**How it works:** `GET /api/tax/summary?fy`. Rows are bucketed by each sale's transfer date using the rules table: rule set from 1-Apr-2018 — STCG listed equity 15%, LTCG listed equity 10%, LTCG with indexation 20%, without 20%, listed bonds without indexation 10%, VDA 30%; from 23-Jul-2024 — 20%, 12.5%, 20% (indexed, property bought before 23-Jul-2024), 12.5%, 12.5%, 30%. Sec. 112A exemption ₹1,00,000 (from FY 2018-19), ₹1,25,000 (from FY 2024-25), applied once per FY to the higher-rate part first. Set-off within the year: short-term losses against any capital gain, long-term losses only against long-term gains, highest-rate gains first (Sec. 112 before 112A); intraday losses stay within speculation; VDA losses offset nothing. F&O: net P&L of closed trades in the FY, taxed at the slab rate if positive; audit flag when turnover > ₹10,00,00,000. "Rate" column shows tax ÷ taxable, or the statutory rate when nothing is taxable.

**Related features:** F-TAX-003, F-TAX-007, F-ANLYT-007.

### Tax Harvest tab <!-- F-TAX-009 -->
**What it does:** Cards **Total Unrealised Loss**, **STCG Loss Available** (with "Realised STCG this FY"), **LTCG Loss Available** (with "Realised LTCG this FY") and a table "Holdings sorted by unrealised loss (harvest candidates)": Asset, Class, Portfolio, Qty, Avg, CMP, Invested, Value, P&L, %, Classification (STCG LOSS, LTCG LOSS, STCG GAIN, LTCG GAIN), Days to LTCG.

**Why it exists:** Shows which holdings could be sold at a loss to offset this year's gains (tax-loss harvesting). From the page text.

**Where to find it:** **Planning → Tax Planning → Tax Harvest**.

**Who can use it:** R-FREE, R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO; R-MANAGER.

**Steps**
1. Open the tab. Biggest losses are listed first.
2. Read **Days to LTCG**: "LTCG ✓" means all units are already long-term; otherwise the days left (hover for the oldest buy date).

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | — | — | — |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable — view only.

**Settings and toggles here:** S-TAX-001 (for the realised-gain lines).

**Results:** View only; nothing is sold.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "No holdings to analyse." | No capital-asset holdings | — |

**Limitations:** The footnote says classification "uses the oldest BUY in the lot — actual FIFO matching at sell time may differ", but the server now classifies by remaining FIFO lots; **Days to LTCG** is computed in the browser with 365 days (equity, ETF, mutual funds), 730 (foreign equity) or 1095 (others), which can differ from the server's rules for non-equity funds bought after 23-Jul-2024 (24 months). Colouring: 7 days or fewer shows in the positive colour, 8–30 days amber.

**How it works:** `GET /api/tax/harvest?fy`. For each capital-asset holding the remaining FIFO lots are valued at today's price; lot P&L is split into short- and long-term; classification is by the larger of the two; holdings with no transaction history count as one short-term lot. Rows sorted by unrealised P&L ascending. Deposits, PF, insurance and similar classes are skipped.

**Related features:** F-ANLYT-008.
