### What this area doesn't do
- It does not transfer any asset or act as a will; it shares information only.
- Nominees never get edit access or a login.
- You can't set different release rules per nominee; one trigger applies to the whole plan.
- A manager can't set up or view Succession for a managed family member.
- There is no SMS reminder; all notices are email.

## Will Maker

**Will Maker** helps you "Write a simple will under Indian law from your EveryPaisa data, check it, and download it to sign." It is an 8-step wizard (Overview, Your details, People & roles, Assets & liabilities, Allocate, Instructions, Review, Preview) followed by step 9, **Sign and store**. Your asset list is pulled from your EveryPaisa accounts; rules check the will before a PDF can be generated; signed copies are stored and a review reminder fires every two years. Every page carries the disclaimer: "This is not legal advice. Passing these checks does not guarantee that your will is legally valid. Get it reviewed by a qualified advocate before you sign it."

### Will Maker overview <!-- F-WILL-001 -->
**What it does:** Shows your will's status (**Not created**, **Draft**, **Generated**, **Executed**), the current draft or latest generated version with its actions, an indicative estate (Assets, Liabilities, Net worth), a "Key things to prepare" list and the disclaimer.

**Why it exists:** Page description: "Write a simple will under Indian law from your EveryPaisa data, check it, and download it to sign."

**Where to find it:** **Planning → Will Maker** (route `/will`).

**Who can use it:** R-PLUS, R-FAMILY, R-PRO. Below PLUS the page shows the lock card "Will Maker is locked" plus "Your will documents" (F-WILL-013). While managing someone's account (R-MANAGER) it shows "Will Maker works on your own account only. Switch back to your own account to make or view your will."

**Steps**
1. Open **Planning → Will Maker**.
2. With nothing yet, click **Create my will** ("About 15-20 minutes. Your progress is saved as you go."). The wizard opens at **Your details**.
3. With a draft: **Continue** or **Discard draft** (confirm "Discard this draft?" — "You can't get it back." → **Discard**; toast "Draft discarded").
4. With a generated will: **Download PDF**, **Sign and store** (or **Signed copy** once signed), **Start a new version** (not yet signed) or **My circumstances changed** (signed).

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Create my will** | Button | Starts a draft | Only when no draft and no generated will; disabled while starting |
| **Continue** | Button | Opens the draft at its saved step | Only with a draft |
| **Discard draft** | Button | Deletes the draft after confirmation | Only with a draft |
| **Download PDF** | Button | Downloads the latest version's PDF | Only with a generated will; disabled while any download runs |
| **Sign and store** / **Signed copy** | Link | Opens step 9 (F-WILL-012) | Only with a generated will |
| **Start a new version** | Button | New draft copied from the latest version | Only when generated, not signed, and no draft |
| **My circumstances changed** | Button | New draft copied from the signed version | Only when signed and no draft |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable — no data entry.

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** Drafts are created as the next version number. If a draft already exists, any create action opens it instead.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Couldn't load Will Maker" | Overview request failed | Reload |
| "Couldn't start your will" / "Couldn't start a new version" | Server refused | Retry |
| "N source(s) could not be read right now." | Some asset sources failed while totalling the estate | Refresh later |

**Limitations:** The estate tiles are indicative ("From your EveryPaisa accounts today. Insurance paid to nominees (₹…) is not counted.") and are recomputed on each visit. Only one draft can exist at a time ("You already have a draft will. Continue it or discard it first.").

**How it works:** `GET /api/will` (WILL_MAKER plan, refuses managing). Collects the estate from all asset sources (bank accounts, investments, provident fund, property, rental property, vehicles, insurance, money lent, loans, credit cards; at most 400 items) and totals assets, liabilities, net and nominee-only amounts. `POST /api/will/drafts` (optionally from an earlier will) and `DELETE /api/will/drafts/:id`. Will contents are stored encrypted per user.

**Related features:** F-WILL-002, F-WILL-003, F-WILL-004, F-WILL-012, F-WILL-013.

### Will history <!-- F-WILL-002 -->
**What it does:** Card **History** listing every version (newest first) with its status badge and a line such as "Started … - generated … - signed … - replaced by version N - next review …", with **PDF** and **Signed copy** buttons where they exist.

**Why it exists:** Inferred from behavior: keeps every earlier version and its signed copy reachable after a new version replaces it.

**Where to find it:** **Planning → Will Maker → History** card.

**Who can use it:** Same as F-WILL-001.

**Steps**

| **Signed copy** | Link | Opens `/will/<id>/execute` | Only when a signed copy is stored |

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** Downloads only.

**Errors and troubleshooting**

|---|---|---|
| "Couldn't download the PDF" / "The PDF for this version is no longer stored" | File missing | Generate a new version |

**Limitations:** Discarded drafts are not listed.

**How it works:** History comes from the overview response; PDFs are served by `GET /api/will/versions/:vid/pdf` (no plan gate) with an integrity check.

### Will review reminders <!-- F-WILL-003 -->
**What it does:** Two years after you sign (and every two years after a review), a banner "Time to review your will" appears on Will Maker and an alert "Time to review your will" is created. You can answer **Reviewed - no changes** or **My circumstances changed**.

**Why it exists:** Banner text: "Check your will every two years, and whenever your family or finances change - a marriage, a birth, a death, or buying or selling property."

**Where to find it:** **Planning → Will Maker** (banner) and **Tools → Alerts** (D-WILL-001).

**Who can use it:** Owners of a signed will on PLUS or above (the reminder alert is created on any plan).

**Steps**
1. When due, open Will Maker and read "Version N was due for a review on <date>…".
2. Click **Reviewed - no changes** — toast "Thanks. We'll remind you again on <date>." — or **My circumstances changed** to start a new version.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Reviewed - no changes** | Button | Moves the next review two years from today and closes the alert | Disabled while busy |
| **My circumstances changed** | Button | Starts a new draft from the signed will | Disabled while busy |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable — no data entry.

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** Next review date = today + 2 years. Generating a new version closes open review alerts.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Couldn't save your review" | Request failed | Retry |

**Limitations:** The alert is created by a daily job at 09:15 IST, so it can appear up to a day after the due date. Users who are inactive or scheduled for deletion are skipped. The job is off when `ENABLE_ALERT_CRONS=false`.

**How it works:** `POST /api/will/wills/:id/reviewed`. `willReviewJob` reads due users under a system context, then runs each user's alert sync in that user's own context; one alert per will per due date, older ones are closed.

**Related features:** F-WILL-001, F-WILL-012, D-WILL-001.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/will/WillReviewBanner.tsx:6`, `apps/web/src/pages/will/WillOverviewPage.tsx:125`, `packages/api/src/jobs/willReviewJob.ts:72`, `packages/api/src/services/will/willReview.service.ts:55`, `packages/api/src/services/will/willReview.service.ts:102`, `packages/shared/src/will/execution.ts:11`

### Will wizard: navigation and saving <!-- F-WILL-004 -->
**What it does:** The frame around steps 2–8: a stepper (full row on wide screens, "Step N of 8" bar on narrow), **Back** and **Next**, a save status ("Saving...", "All changes saved", "Not saved"), automatic saving, and protection against edits from another tab.

**Why it exists:** Overview text: "Your progress is saved as you go."

**Where to find it:** `/will/:id/<step>` (details, people, estate, allocation, instructions, review, preview).

**Who can use it:** Same as F-WILL-001.

**Steps**
1. Edit the step; changes save automatically about 0.8 s after you stop typing.
2. Click **Next** (or a step in the stepper). The page saves first and then moves.
3. If a save fails, click **Retry** next to "Could not save your changes. Check your connection and try again."
4. If another tab changed the will, click **Reload**.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stepper steps | Buttons | Save and go to that step | Wide screens only (≥ 900 px) |
| **Back** | Button | Save and go back (step 2 goes to the overview) | After two failed saves you may leave anyway |
| **Next** | Button | Save and go forward | Disabled while loading, and on **Review** while any blocker remains; hidden on **Preview** |
| **Retry** | Button | Retries the save | Shown after a failed save |
| **Reload** | Button | Reloads the latest version | Shown on a conflict |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable here (see each step).

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** Each section is saved separately with the revision it builds on.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "This will was changed in another tab or device. Reload to see the latest version - your last change here was not saved." | Revision conflict | **Reload** |
| "This draft could not be opened." | Draft missing or discarded | **Back to Will Maker** |
| "This request is too large." | Body over 512 KB | Shorten text |

**Limitations:** While a conflict is shown, the step is read-only.

**How it works:** `GET /api/will/drafts/:id`, `PUT /api/will/drafts/:id/sections/:section` with revision; a revision mismatch returns 409 "This will was changed in another tab or device. Reload to continue." Rules (`runWillRules`) run in the browser on every change.

**Related features:** F-WILL-005 to F-WILL-011.

### Step 4: Assets & liabilities <!-- F-WILL-007 -->
**What it does:** Lists the assets and liabilities fetched from your EveryPaisa accounts with value, ownership (**Sole**, **Joint**, **Nominee only**, **HUF**) and your share, and a review status per item (**Confirmed**, **Needs review**, **Excluded**, **Not found on refresh**). You can refresh from your accounts and add items by hand.

**Why it exists:** Inferred from behavior: the will's estate schedule is built from the data already in EveryPaisa, with the owner confirming each item.

**Who can use it:** Same as F-WILL-001.

2. For each item set **Ownership** (Joint/HUF ask for your share %), then **Confirm**, **Exclude** or **Include**.
3. Click **Add an asset or liability**, enter **What is it**, **Type**, **Value**, click **Add**. Manual items can be **Edit value**d or **Remove**d.
4. Click **Refresh from my accounts** to re-read your accounts.

| Share % | Decimal field | Your share | Joint and HUF only |
| **Confirm** | Button | Marks reviewed | Needs review / Not found on refresh |
| **Exclude** / **Include** | Button | Leaves the item out / back in | — |

| **What is it** | Text | Yes | ≤ 160 | Empty | — |

**Errors and troubleshooting**

### Step 5: Allocate <!-- F-WILL-008 -->
**What it does:** Decides who gets what: **By percentage** (the residuary estate shared in percentages that must total 100%, shown in a donut chart), **Specific gifts** (a share of a particular asset to a person), **Fixed amounts** (a rupee amount to a person), and how long someone must outlive you to inherit.

**Why it exists:** Tab text: "Everything not given away as a specific gift or a fixed amount is shared in these percentages."

**Where to find it:** Wizard step **Allocate** (`/will/:id/allocation`).

**Who can use it:** Same as F-WILL-001.

**Steps**
1. **By percentage**: use **Add someone to the split** (new rows take the remaining %), adjust each share, or click **Split equally**. The total line reads "Total 100.00%" in green when correct.
2. **Specific gifts**: choose **Asset** ("… - N% left") and **To**, click **Add gift**, then adjust the share.
3. **Fixed amounts**: choose **Person**, enter **Amount**, click **Add amount**.
4. Choose **How long must someone outlive you to inherit?**

| **Add gift** | Button | Adds a specific gift | Disabled until asset and person chosen, for a duplicate pair, or when the asset has 0% left |

| **Remove** | Buttons | Remove a row | — |

| Residuary total | — | Blocker | Exactly 100% | — | "The percentage split adds up to X% - it must be exactly 100%." / "Share the rest of your estate - the percentages must add up to 100%." |

### Step 7: Review <!-- F-WILL-010 -->
**What it does:** A checklist of every rule with a tick, warning or cross and the message for each problem, a **Fix** button that jumps to the right step (and tab), "Your will at a glance" totals, and a "Legal review recommended" note. **Next** stays disabled while any blocker remains.

**Why it exists:** Heading text: "N things to fix before you can preview" / "Ready to preview".

**Where to find it:** Wizard step **Review** (`/will/:id/review`).

**Who can use it:** Same as F-WILL-001.

**Steps**
1. Read each check. Click **Fix** next to a problem to jump there.
2. When the heading says "Ready to preview", click **Next**.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Fix** | Button | Goes to the step/tab that fixes the check | Only on failing checks |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable — view only.

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** Nothing saved here.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Something needs another look" | A finding from a rule not in the list | **Fix** |

**Limitations:** Passing every check does not mean the will is legally valid (disclaimer).

**How it works:** Lists `WILL_RULES` except the legal-review info rule; "At a glance" shows Assets, Liabilities, Net estate, People named, Specific gifts and Money gifts.

**Related features:** F-WILL-005 to F-WILL-009, F-WILL-011.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/will/steps/ReviewStep.tsx:9`, `apps/web/src/pages/will/steps/ReviewStep.tsx:15`, `apps/web/src/pages/will/WillWizardPage.tsx:107`, `packages/shared/src/will/validation/rules.ts:303`

### Step 8: Preview and generate the PDF <!-- F-WILL-011 -->
**What it does:** Shows a summary and the full text of the will as it will print, asks you to tick the acknowledgement, and generates the PDF as a new numbered version.

**Why it exists:** Code comment: "A preview is what the user consents to, so it is never served from cache".

**Where to find it:** Wizard step **Preview** (`/will/:id/preview`).

**Who can use it:** Same as F-WILL-001.

**Steps**
1. Wait for "Preparing your preview...". Read the summary and document.
2. Tick: "I understand that EveryPaisa is not a law firm, that this will is produced from a fixed template, and that I should have it reviewed by a qualified advocate before I sign it."
3. Click **Generate PDF**. "Version N is ready" appears with next steps.
4. Click **Download PDF**, **Next: sign and store** or **Back to Will Maker**.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| Acknowledgement checkbox | Checkbox | Consent | Resets whenever the preview reloads |
| **Generate PDF** | Button | Generates the version | Disabled until ticked, with blockers, or while generating |
| **Download PDF** / **Next: sign and store** / **Back to Will Maker** | Buttons | After generation | — |
| **Go to Review** / **Reload preview** / **Retry** | Buttons | Recovery actions | Shown only in those states |

**Fields and rules:** Acknowledgement required ("Please confirm you have read the note about legal review").

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** The draft becomes **Generated**; any earlier generated or signed version becomes superseded ("replaced by version N"); open review reminders close; the PDF is stored in your documents.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Fix the items on the Review step first." | Blockers | **Go to Review** |
| "Your preview is from an earlier day - reload it to see the will with today's date before you generate." | The date changed | **Reload preview** |
| "Your will changed since this preview. Reload the preview to see the latest version before you generate." | Revision changed | **Reload preview** |
| "Couldn't prepare the preview" / "Couldn't create your will" | Server error | **Retry** |

**Limitations:** Generation is limited to 5 per minute. The PDF footer reads "Prepared with EveryPaisa Will Maker from a fixed template. Not legal advice - have it reviewed by a qualified advocate."

**How it works:** `GET /api/will/drafts/:id/preview` (audit "will_viewed") and `POST /api/will/drafts/:id/generate` with revision, acknowledgement and the preview date. The server re-checks rules, renders the PDF with the running head "Last Will and Testament of <name>", stores it as a document named "will-v<N>.pdf", seals a snapshot, and writes the audit row "will_generated".

**Related features:** F-WILL-010, F-WILL-012, D-WILL-002.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/will/steps/PreviewStep.tsx:18`, `apps/web/src/pages/will/steps/PreviewStep.tsx:48`, `apps/web/src/pages/will/steps/PreviewStep.tsx:129`, `packages/api/src/routes/will.routes.ts:60`, `packages/api/src/services/will/willGenerate.service.ts:72`, `packages/api/src/services/will/willGenerate.service.ts:116`, `packages/shared/src/will/wire.ts:120`

### Sign and store (step 9) <!-- F-WILL-012 -->
**What it does:** Explains how to sign the will correctly, links to free legal help, and records the signing date and two witnesses with a scan or photo of the signed will. Once stored, the will shows as **Executed** and the next review is set two years ahead.

**Why it exists:** Page description: "Step 9: sign your will the right way, then keep a copy of the signed will here."

**Where to find it:** **Will Maker → Sign and store** (route `/will/:id/execute`).

**Who can use it:** Same as F-WILL-001 for storing; downloading a stored signed copy works on any plan.

**Steps**
1. Follow the guide: Print the will; Read it once more; Choose two witnesses; Sign in front of both witnesses; Register it with the Sub-Registrar (optional); Store it safely.
2. Enter **Date you signed**, **Witness 1 - full name**, **Witness 2 - full name** and choose the **Signed copy (PDF or photo, up to 20 MB)**.
3. Click **Store signed copy**. The toast "Your signed will is stored" appears; the card shows "Signed on <date>", the witnesses and "Next review <date>".
4. Later use **Download signed copy** or **Replace the copy or fix details** (leave the file empty to keep the stored copy).

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Download PDF** | Button | Downloads the generated will | — |
| **Store signed copy** | Button | Saves the record | Disabled while saving |
| **Download signed copy** | Button | Downloads the stored copy | Only when stored |
| **Replace the copy or fix details** | Button | Reopens the form | Only for the current will |
| **Cancel** | Button | Closes the edit form | Only when editing |
| Tele-Law / NALSA links | Links | Free legal help (NALSA helpline 15100) | — |

**Fields and rules**
| Field | Type | Required | Format / limits | Default | Error shown (exact) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Date you signed** | Date | Yes | Not in the future; not before the generation date | Empty | "Enter the date you signed." / "The signing date cannot be in the future." / "The signing date cannot be before the will was generated (<date>)." |
| **Witness 1/2 - full name** | Text | Yes | ≥ 2 characters each, ≤ 120, two different people, not you | Empty | "Enter the full name of both witnesses." / "Your two witnesses must be two different people." / "You cannot be a witness to your own will. Choose someone else." |
| **Signed copy** | File | First time only | PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP (checked by content), ≤ 20 MB | — | "Attach the signed copy." / "Upload the signed will as a PDF or a photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP)." / "The file is larger than 20 MB." |

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** Status **Executed**; witness names stored encrypted ("Witness names are stored encrypted and shown only to you."); the signed copy stored as "will-v<N>-signed.<ext>"; next review = signing date + 2 years (correcting witnesses with the same date keeps the review date).

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "This will can't be signed and stored here: it is still a draft or was discarded." | Not generated | Generate first |
| "This will can't be signed and stored any more" | It was replaced meanwhile | Open the current version |
| "This will changed while you were saving. Reload and try again." | Concurrent change | Reload |
| Amber warning "One of your witnesses has the same name as a beneficiary…" | Witness name matches a beneficiary | Speak to a lawyer; consider re-signing |

**Limitations:** A superseded version's record is read-only ("This version was replaced by a newer version. Its record is kept here as history."). Uploads are limited to 10 per minute.

**How it works:** `GET /api/will/wills/:id/execution`; `POST /api/will/wills/:id/execution` (multipart, one file, multer limit 20 MB, type sniffed from bytes); `GET /api/will/wills/:id/signed-copy` (no plan gate).

**Related features:** F-WILL-003, F-WILL-011, F-WILL-013.

**Sources:** `apps/web/src/pages/will/execute/WillExecutePage.tsx:19`, `apps/web/src/pages/will/execute/WillExecutePage.tsx:84`, `apps/web/src/pages/will/execute/SignedCopyForm.tsx:33`, `apps/web/src/pages/will/execute/executeCopy.ts:5`, `apps/web/src/pages/will/execute/executeCopy.ts:52`, `packages/shared/src/will/execution.ts:13`, `packages/api/src/services/will/willExecute.service.ts:43`, `packages/api/src/services/will/willExecute.service.ts:113`, `packages/api/src/middleware/willUpload.ts:16`

### Will documents after a plan lapse <!-- F-WILL-013 -->
**What it does:** Below PLUS, Will Maker is locked but the card "Your will documents" still offers **Download PDF** and **Download signed copy** for your current version: "Version N stays yours to download on any plan."

**Why it exists:** Code comment: "A user always keeps their own will, whatever their plan".

**Where to find it:** **Planning → Will Maker** when your plan is below PLUS.

**Controls**
| Control (exact label) | Type | What it does | Disabled / hidden when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Download PDF** | Button | Downloads the current version | Card hidden with no generated will |
| **Download signed copy** | Button | Downloads the signed copy | Only when stored |

**Fields and rules:** Not applicable — downloads only.

**Settings and toggles here:** None.

**Results:** Files download; nothing changes.

**Errors and troubleshooting**
| Message / symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Couldn't download the file" | Download failed | Retry |

**Limitations:** Editing, new versions and storing a signed copy need PLUS.

### What this area doesn't do
- It does not support wills under foreign law or Muslim personal law.
- It does not give legal advice or register the will; registration is your step at the Sub-Registrar.
- You can't make or view a will for a managed family member, even as their keeper.
- You can't edit a generated version; changes need a new version.
- Only one draft can exist at a time.

## Roles and profiles

### Signed-out visitor <!-- R-VISITOR -->
- **Who:** anyone without a valid session (never signed up, signed out, or session expired).
- **Gets/loses it:** by not being signed in; becomes R-FREE (or higher) on sign-in.
- **Can:** open `/login`, `/register`, `/forgot-password`, `/privacy`, `/legal/ai-use`; open emailed token links that are deliberately outside the protected tree — family invitation accept (`/families/invitations/:token/accept`), profile claim (`/family/claims/:token`), Succession links (`/legacy/ok|ack|verify|access/:token`), professional invitation (`/professional-invitations/:token`). Public API: token "peek" endpoints, profile claim, Succession public actions (`packages/api/src/routes/families.routes.ts:65`, `packages/api/src/routes/families.routes.ts:88`, `packages/api/src/routes/legacy.routes.ts:39`).
- **Can't:** reach any page inside the app shell; any unknown URL also redirects to `/login` because the 404 page sits inside the protected shell (`apps/web/src/App.tsx:282`). `/connect/authorize` and `/onboarding` send the visitor to `/login` and back (`apps/web/src/App.tsx:139`).
- **Plan limits:** not applicable.
- Sources: `apps/web/src/App.tsx:111`, `apps/web/src/App.tsx:122`, `apps/web/src/App.tsx:125`, `apps/web/src/App.tsx:133`, `apps/web/src/components/layout/ProtectedRoute.tsx:13`.

### Free user <!-- R-FREE -->
- **Who:** any signed-in account whose effective plan is `FREE`. Covers user roles `INVESTOR`, `HNI`, `FAMILY_OFFICE`, `ADVISOR`, `CA` — identical access verified: these roles are self-assignable and refused by `requireRole` (`packages/api/src/middleware/authenticate.ts:76`); no other code branches on them.
- **Gets it:** every new account starts on FREE (registration never accepts a plan; `packages/api/src/controllers/auth.controller.ts:44`). A paid user drops back here when `planExpiresAt` passes (`packages/api/src/lib/effectivePlan.ts:16`). There is no automatic renewal: a Razorpay payment sets 30 days (monthly) or 365 days (annual) (`packages/api/src/services/billing/planActivation.service.ts:4`).
- **Loses it:** by paying for a higher plan on **Pricing** (`packages/api/src/routes/billing.routes.ts:83`).
- **Can:** use every ungated module on their own data: dashboard, 1 portfolio, transactions, all asset-class pages (manual entry), imports, Gmail inbox, CAS, alerts, settings, reports outside the PLUS catalog, Split Expenses, EMI Calculator, Account Access (see/withdraw professionals — never plan-gated, `packages/api/src/routes/ca.routes.ts:178`), join a family someone else created (accept invitation), act for a client who invited them (R-PROF), be a Succession nominee.
- **Can't:** any PLUS/FAMILY/PRO_ADVISOR feature in the table above; AI Assistant answers are tier-locked (quota 0).
- **Plan limits:** 1 portfolio.
- Sources: `packages/shared/src/entitlements.ts:83`, `packages/api/src/ai/rateLimit.ts:44`, `apps/web/src/pages/pricing/PricingPage.tsx:30`.

### Plus subscriber <!-- R-PLUS -->
- **Who:** signed-in account with effective plan `PLUS` (UI name "Plus").
- **Gets/loses it:** Razorpay checkout on **Pricing** (₹499/month or ₹4,999/year — `packages/shared/src/pricing.ts:19`); lapses to R-FREE at `planExpiresAt`.
- **Can:** everything R-FREE can, plus: up to 5 portfolios, tax/CA report catalog, AA/Finvu auto-import, AI insights, AI Assistant (100 messages/day), goal projections (Goals), AI connectors, Advisor engine, MF analytics, Will Maker, Documents sorter, Succession configuration.
- **Can't:** create a family, family dashboard, accounting module, CA practice onboarding, F&O Schedule 43.
- Sources: `packages/shared/src/entitlements.ts:26`, `packages/api/src/ai/rateLimit.ts:41`, `apps/web/src/pages/pricing/PricingPage.tsx:41`.

### Family subscriber <!-- R-FAMILY -->
- **Who:** effective plan `FAMILY` (UI "Family").
- **Gets/loses it:** Razorpay checkout (₹899/month — `packages/shared/src/pricing.ts:23`); lapses to R-FREE.
- **Can:** everything R-PLUS can, plus create families and use the family dashboard (FAMILY_SHARING); AI Assistant 200/day. Seat math: `Family.includedSeats` default 3, extra seat ₹199 (placeholders, `packages/api/prisma/schema.prisma:3789`).
- **Can't:** accounting module, CA practice onboarding, Schedule 43.
- **Plan limits:** 5 portfolios.
- Sources: `packages/shared/src/entitlements.ts:34`, `packages/api/src/routes/families.routes.ts:180`, `packages/api/src/ai/rateLimit.ts:39`.

### Pro/Advisor subscriber <!-- R-PRO -->
- **Who:** effective plan `PRO_ADVISOR` (UI "Pro/Advisor").
- **Gets/loses it:** Razorpay checkout (₹1,999/month — `packages/shared/src/pricing.ts:24`); lapses to R-FREE.
- **Can:** everything R-FAMILY can, plus Accounting (Trial Balance, P&L, Balance Sheet, Chart of Accounts, Tally export), onboarding your own clients into the CA workspace (still needs two-factor), F&O Schedule 43; unlimited portfolios; AI Assistant 500/day. The **Upgrade** header button and sidebar upgrade card are hidden only for this plan.
- **Can't:** admin tools (unless also R-ADMIN).
- Sources: `packages/shared/src/entitlements.ts:63`, `packages/shared/src/entitlements.ts:86`, `apps/web/src/components/layout/Header.tsx:114`, `apps/web/src/components/layout/UpgradeSidebarCard.tsx:22`.

### Administrator <!-- R-ADMIN -->
- **Who:** account with `User.role = ADMIN`. Orthogonal to plan: an admin's features still follow their own plan (no plan bypass, `packages/api/src/middleware/requirePlan.ts:6`).
- **Gets it:** not through the app — registration rejects `ADMIN` with "Cannot self-register with this role" (`packages/api/src/controllers/auth.controller.ts:44`); no script or endpoint in the repo grants it. **Loses it:** only out-of-band.
- **Can (admin-only):** set own plan without payment on **Pricing** (needs two-factor; `packages/api/src/routes/billing.routes.ts:135`, `apps/web/src/pages/pricing/PricingPage.tsx:228`); review/correct lender loan rates at `/settings/loan-rates` (needs two-factor; `packages/api/src/routes/adminLoanRates.routes.ts:17`; link shown in Settings only to admins, `apps/web/src/pages/settings/SettingsPage.tsx:176`); edit MF qualitative facts at `/admin/mf-qualitative-facts` (no two-factor, no nav link; `packages/api/src/routes/mfQualitativeFacts.routes.ts:48`); Succession "test mode" (`packages/api/src/services/legacy/plan.service.ts:93`, `apps/web/src/pages/legacy/LegacyPage.tsx:132`). Active admins also receive data-ops alert emails from scheduled jobs (e.g. `packages/api/src/jobs/mfOpsAlertsJob.ts:75`).
- **Can't:** use a role guard while acting for a managed profile (acting identity is always `INVESTOR`, `packages/api/src/services/family/managedProfile.service.ts:109`).
- Note: `requireRole` answers a non-admin with **401** "Insufficient role", not 403 (`packages/api/src/middleware/authenticate.ts:95`).

### Family owner <!-- R-FAMOWNER -->
- **Who:** an ACTIVE `FamilyMember` with role `OWNER`, while the header switcher is set to that family (overlay on any plan role). The family creator becomes OWNER; a family may have several OWNERs.
- **Gets/loses it:** create a family (needs FAMILY plan) or be promoted by an owner; loses it when demoted, removed or on leaving.
- **Can (in family view):** read every active member's personal data and all family-shared portfolios, with no asset-class/category caps; write family-shared portfolios; invite/remove/edit members and their visibility caps (owner checks inside the service, e.g. `assertOwnerOf`). Writes to other members' *personal* data are never allowed.
- Sources: `packages/api/prisma/schema.prisma:3756`, `packages/api/src/services/family/familyScope.service.ts:182`, `packages/api/src/routes/families.routes.ts:56`.

### Family contributor <!-- R-FAMCONTRIB -->
- **Who:** ACTIVE `FamilyMember` with role `CONTRIBUTOR` (the default role for invitations), in family view.
- **Gets/loses it:** accept an owner's invitation; loses it on removal/leave/role change.
- **Can (in family view):** read the family's members' data and family-shared portfolios **filtered by their own** `visibleAssetClasses` / `visibleCategories` (empty list = sees nothing in that dimension); write family-shared portfolios; write only their own personal data.
- **Can't:** manage members; see beyond their caps.
- Sources: `packages/api/src/services/family/familyScope.service.ts:180`, `packages/api/src/services/family/familyScope.service.ts:207`, `packages/api/prisma/schema.prisma:3800`.

### Family viewer <!-- R-FAMVIEWER -->
- **Who:** ACTIVE `FamilyMember` with role `VIEWER`, in family view.
- **Gets/loses it:** invitation with role VIEWER; removal/leave/role change.
- **Can:** same visibility as R-FAMCONTRIB.
- **Can't:** write family-shared portfolios (`writableFamilyIds` empty); manage members.
- Sources: `packages/api/src/services/family/familyScope.service.ts:207`.

### Managing a family member's account <!-- R-MANAGER -->
- **Who:** a signed-in user who switched into a **managed profile** (a family member with no login whose account they keep) from the user menu ("Accounts you manage"). The web adds `X-Act-As` to data requests and shows the banner "You are managing <name>'s account. Everything you add here is theirs." with **Back to my account**.
- **Gets/loses it:** the profile must have `managedById` = this user, be an active shadow profile, and both must be ACTIVE in the same family — re-checked on **every** request, so removal ends it on the next click. Leaving via **Back to my account**.
- **Can:** read and write the managed person's data on data routes; features follow the **manager's** plan (`plan: manager.plan`).
- **Can't:** any "account route" — `/api/auth`, `/api/billing`, `/api/families`, `/api/ca`, `/api/me`, `/api/professional-invitations`, `/api/managed-profiles`, `/api/gmail`, `/api/mailboxes`, `/api/legacy` (error "Switch back to your own account to do this."); Will Maker and AI connectors also refuse (`packages/api/src/routes/will.routes.ts:15`, `packages/api/src/routes/connect.routes.ts:14`); the onboarding wizard redirects to `/portfolios` (`apps/web/src/components/family/NotWhileManaging.tsx:13`).
- Sources: `packages/api/src/middleware/authenticate.ts:40`, `packages/api/src/middleware/authenticate.ts:48`, `packages/api/src/services/family/managedProfile.service.ts:37`, `packages/api/src/services/family/managedProfile.service.ts:113`, `apps/web/src/api/client.ts:48`, `apps/web/src/components/family/ActingAsBanner.tsx:24`, `apps/web/src/components/layout/Header.tsx:236`.

### Professional acting for a client <!-- R-PROF -->
- **Who:** an accountant/advisor (any plan) who holds an ACTIVE `Client` grant on someone's books — sidebar entry **Client books** (`/ca`) appears once they hold at least one.
- **Gets it:** the account holder invites them from **Account Access** and they accept (`/professional-invitations/:token`), free for the professional; or an R-PRO practice invites/creates the client. **Loses it:** client or professional revokes; `accessFrom`/`accessUntil` window ends (enforced in the database).
- **Can:** with two-factor sign-in on and used this session — read the client's books within the grant scope (all or listed portfolios / asset classes / categories); edit only what the client allowed (`canEditBooks`, `canEditTransactions`, `canEditImports`, `canEditFmv`, all off by default); add and correct transactions.
- **Can't:** delete a client transaction (no route, no RLS policy, `packages/api/src/routes/ca.routes.ts:132`); open the workspace without two-factor.
- Sources: `packages/api/src/routes/ca.routes.ts:71`, `packages/api/src/routes/ca.routes.ts:73`, `packages/api/src/routes/ca.routes.ts:90`, `packages/api/src/services/ca/caAccess.service.ts:132`, `packages/api/prisma/schema.prisma:520`, `apps/web/src/components/layout/SidebarNav.tsx:170`, `apps/web/src/components/ca/ProfessionalTwoFactorGate.tsx:15`.

### AI chatbot connection <!-- R-AICONN -->
- **Who:** an external chatbot (ChatGPT or Claude) the user connected through **AI connectors** (OAuth approval at `/connect/authorize`); it calls `/mcp` with a bearer token (`epa_` prefix).
- **Gets/loses it:** user approves (needs PLUS); revoked from AI connectors (takes effect on the next call — no caching); token expiry. Only available when the operator sets `MCP_ENABLED=true`.
- **Can:** read-only access to the approved data areas (Investments, Retirement, Banking and cards, Loans, Insurance, Property, Vehicles, Goals and tax, Split expenses on by default; Will and succession, Documents off by default) and to opted-in family members.
- **Can't:** write anything; act while the user is managing someone else's account.
- Sources: `packages/api/src/routes/mcp.routes.ts:22`, `packages/api/src/services/mcp/oauth.service.ts:316`, `packages/shared/src/aiConnector.ts:6`, `packages/shared/src/aiConnector.ts:13`, `packages/api/src/routes/connect.routes.ts:28`.

### Succession nominee <!-- R-NOMINEE -->
- **Who:** a person named as nominee in someone's **Succession** plan; usually has no account.
- **Gets it:** after the plan releases, they receive a `/legacy/access/:token` link, confirm with a one-time code, and get a nominee session (`x-legacy-session`). **Loses it:** session expiry ("Session expired. Open your link again."), owner revokes.
- **Can:** read-only view of what the owner released, its PDF and released documents (`/api/legacy-view`).
- **Can't:** reach any other API — a nominee session is never a user token.
- Sources: `apps/web/src/App.tsx:128`, `packages/api/src/middleware/legacySession.ts:10`, `packages/api/src/routes/legacy.routes.ts:43`, `packages/api/src/routes/legacy.routes.ts:49`.

## Glossary

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 80C + 24(b) | Income-tax deductions for home loans: principal under 80C (up to ₹1,50,000 overall) and interest under 24(b) (up to ₹2,00,000 for a self-occupied home). |
| 80E | Income-tax deduction for interest on an education loan, uncapped, for up to 8 years. |
| Account Access | Your page listing the accountants and advisors you have let into your books, what each can reach, and everything they have done; you can withdraw access here on any plan. |
| Account Aggregator (Finvu) | RBI-regulated consent framework, via Finvu, for pulling financial data; consents are started on the Connectors page |
| Accounts you manage | User-menu list of family members without their own login whose accounts you keep; choosing one shows "You are managing <name>'s account". |
| accrued | An interest-earning holding valued at principal plus interest earned so far. |
| Add asset class | Sidebar button that adds an optional class (Bonds, Crypto, Forex, NPS, Post Office) to the sidebar. |
| Add my share to Cash Activity | Switch on a split expense that adds your share as an outflow in your Cash Activity and keeps it updated. |
| Advance tax | Tax paid in four instalments during the year (15 June, 15 September, 15 December, 15 March). |
| AI Assistant | The built-in chat ("Portfolio Assistant") opened from the round button on every page; answers need Plus or higher. |
| AI connectors | Settings page where you connect your own ChatGPT or Claude to your EveryPaisa data (read-only, for the areas you choose). |
| AI-use notice | "How EveryPaisa uses AI in advice" — must be accepted before the assistant answers. |
| AIF | Alternative Investment Fund. |
| Alerts & Reminders | The bell in the header and the Alerts page: maturities, premium due dates, expiries and your own reminders. |
| AMFI NAV | The daily net asset value per unit published by AMFI; used to price mutual fund holdings. |
| Amortization schedule | The month-by-month table of EMI, interest, principal and balance, recomputed from the loan's terms and recorded payments. |
| Anchor (Good condition) | The valuation's base price for a vehicle in Good condition, before the condition sliders. |
| Approve & commit | Accept an event so it is written as a transaction or cash-flow entry. |
| APR (true yearly cost) | The yearly rate that equates what you actually receive (loan minus fees) with everything you repay. |
| as of | The date of the price behind a holding's value; shown amber with ⚠ when older than 5 days (2 days for crypto). |
| Asset Classes | The sidebar section listing each kind of asset or liability you track (Stocks, Mutual Funds, FDs & RDs, Loans, …). You can reorder, hide and add classes. |
| At maturity | The projected amount a deposit or scheme pays at its maturity date. |
| Auto-commit | A monitored-sender setting: its confident events are written without manual review. |
| Auto-created folder | A Documents person folder the app created from a name found on a document. |
| Auto-fetch account | An EPF UAN or PPF bank account linked so its passbook can be fetched from the portal. |
| Auto-matched | A rent month marked received automatically from an imported bank credit. |
| Back to my account | Returns from managing a family member's account to your own. |
| Backup code | One of 10 one-time codes (format ABCD-EFGH) shown when two-factor is turned on; each signs you in once |
| Balance due / To collect / In advance | What the tenant owes (positive) or has paid ahead (negative) on the khata. |
| Billing cycle | Monthly (30 days) or Annual (365 days) when buying a plan |
| Break-even | The month in which cumulative EMI savings first cover the switching costs. |
| Broker Connectors | The Connectors page cards that store your Zerodha, Upstox or Angel One developer keys and broker login |
| Bucket | One of seven advisor asset groups: Equity — Domestic, Equity — International, Debt, Gold, Real assets, Cash equivalent, Other / alternatives. |
| By value / My order | Sort choice for the Asset Classes sidebar section: largest holding first, or the order you set with **Edit**. |
| CAGR (goal) | The yearly return needed from today for a goal's current value to reach its target by the target date. |
| Carat / Purity | Gold fineness (24K, 22K, 18K, 14K) or silver grade (999, 925, 800) used to scale the per-gram price. |
| CAS | Consolidated Account Statement — the statement of your mutual fund and demat holdings that you can request from CAMS, KFintech, NSDL or CDSL by email. |
| Cash Activity | The page of bank credits and debits parsed from your connected accounts (sidebar Overview → Cash Activity). |
| Cash flow | A money-in (**Inflow**) or money-out (**Outflow**) entry created from approved bank alerts, rent and split settlements. |
| CASParser | casparser.in, a third-party service the app uses to request a KFintech CAS by PAN + email. |
| CE / PE | Call option / put option. |
| Challan | A traffic e-challan (fine) issued against a vehicle. |
| Chart of accounts | The tree of ledger accounts vouchers post to. |
| CII | Cost Inflation Index used to index a property's cost for long-term capital gain. |
| Client books | Sidebar entry (page title "Clients") for a professional who has been given access to someone else's books. |
| CMP | Current market price of one unit of a holding. |
| CoinGecko | The crypto price source; a coin "linked to CoinGecko" gets live prices. |
| Collections | The list of active tenants who currently owe money. |
| Coming up | The FDs & RDs list of maturities within 30 days and RD installments due within 7 days or overdue. |
| Connector address | The `/mcp` web address you paste into ChatGPT or Claude |
| Contract note | The broker's legally required record of the trades you made on a day. |
| Contributor (family) | Member who sees other members' data within their visibility caps and can add to family-shared portfolios. |
| Cost basis (property) | Purchase price + stamp duty + registration fee + brokerage + other costs. |
| cost basis / at cost | A holding with no market price is valued at what you paid for it. |
| Coverage check | The page that compares your life, health, vehicle and home cover with what your figures suggest you need. |
| Critical illness cover | A lump sum paid on diagnosis of a listed illness, recorded as Yes / No / Not recorded on a policy. |
| Current value | On asset-class pages: today's value of a holding — market price × units, interest accrued to today for deposits and compounding Post Office schemes, cost for payout schemes, and nothing for classes without a price source. |
| Customer ID | The bank-issued customer number (CIF); the same for all your accounts at one bank. |
| Danger zone | The Settings card holding **Delete account** |
| Data checks | The checks above the Reports tabs that say whether figures are complete and current. |
| Demo mode | Server setting under which Account Aggregator consents are test fixtures approved with **Simulate approval** |
| Deposit held | Security deposit received minus deposit refunds; kept outside the rent balance. |
| Difference in Opening Balances | The balancing line added to the balance sheet when opening balances don't net to zero. |
| Direct / Regular plan | Two plans of the same scheme; Regular includes distributor commission and costs more each year. |
| Drift | Current weight minus target weight of a bucket, in percentage points (pp). 5 pp or more is treated as material. |
| Duplicate / Probably fine | Labels in **Find duplicates**: a set that is almost certainly recorded twice (pre-ticked), or a set with a likely reason to be separate (not ticked). |
| Effective funds | 1 ÷ Σ(weight²) across your funds; how many equal-sized funds your book behaves like. |
| Effective plan | The plan in force: a paid plan past its end date counts as Free |
| EMI | Equated monthly instalment — the fixed monthly payment that repays a loan's principal and interest. |
| Engagement | A professional's active relationship with one client; **Close engagement** ends it from the professional's side. |
| Equity Holdings | The Stocks page table aggregating each stock across portfolios. |
| ETF | Exchange-traded fund; shown with stocks, tagged "ETF". |
| Event | A single financial fact read from an email (a buy, a UPI credit, a premium…) waiting for review or already written to your books. |
| EveryPaisa | The product: a multi-asset portfolio ledger for Indian investors ("A multi-asset ledger for India"). |
| Executed (will) | A generated will whose signing has been recorded. |
| Executor | Person who carries out the will. |
| EXPIRY ? | Status of an F&O position waiting for its expiry close to be approved. |
| Expiry close | A request created on expiry day to close an open F&O contract at the exchange settlement price, approved or rejected on the Expiry tab. |
| F & O | Futures and options (the derivatives asset class). |
| F&O | Futures and options contracts, tracked on the Futures & Options page as positions rather than holdings. |
| Family | Paid plan that adds family sharing (3 seats included), consolidated family net worth and reports, on top of Plus. |
| Family insurance sheet | The printable one-page summary of active policies for your family. |
| Family view / Switch view | Header menu that shows the app as a family's combined data instead of your Personal view. |
| FD | Fixed deposit: a one-time deposit with a bank or issuer. |
| FDs & RDs | Fixed deposits and recurring deposits. |
| Financial Health Score | The 0–100 score and A–F grade on the Portfolio Score page. |
| Finding | One rule result with evidence, from an analysis run. |
| Finvu / Finfactor Wealthscape | An account-aggregator provider and its data API used by the sandbox card. |
| FMV (31 Jan 2018) | Fair market value on 31 January 2018, used to grandfather long-term equity gains under Section 55(2)(ac). |
| Foreclosure | Paying off the whole balance early; recording one closes the loan as Foreclosed. |
| Free | The starting plan for every new account: net worth and dashboard, manual entry across all asset classes, 1 portfolio, basic reports. |
| Free preview | The single locked answer a Free account can see in the AI Assistant. |
| Fund CAGR | The fund's annualised NAV growth from your first purchase date to today. |
| Futures Ledger | The futures section of the F&O open/closed tabs. |
| FX pair | A currency-pair position such as USDINR or EURUSD, treated as speculative business income. |
| FY (financial year) | The Indian April–March tax year, written "2026-27". |
| Grace period | The 30 days between asking to delete an account and its permanent erasure; signing in offers **Restore account** |
| Grandfathering | For equity bought on or before 31 January 2018, cost can be raised to that day's fair market value. |
| Grandfathering / FMV | For equity bought on or before 31-Jan-2018, the cost can be raised to its fair market value (closing price) on that date. |
| Guardian | Adult appointed for children under 18. |
| Hand the account to them | Inviting a managed member to take over their profile with their own email and password. |
| Hide values | The eye button in the top bar that covers amounts and numbers across the app with grey bars; remembered on this browser. |
| Hide values / Show values | Header eye button that masks money amounts on screen on this browser. |
| Holding | What you own of one asset in one portfolio, rebuilt by the app from your transactions (units, cost, current value). |
| House methodology | The firm's signed fund-ranking method, scored nightly, used to name funds in recommendations when enabled. |
| Hypothecation | A lender's charge on a vehicle bought on loan; "Clear" means none recorded. |
| I'm OK | Email link that resets the Succession countdown. |
| IFSC | The 11-character bank branch code (for example HDFC0001234). |
| Import job | One uploaded or emailed file being processed; shown as a row in **Import history** with a status. |
| Inbox | Sidebar section for connecting Gmail ("Connect your Gmail") so statements and alerts are imported from your mailbox. |
| Inbox imports | The Reports tab where documents found by an inbox scan are approved or rejected. |
| Inbox scan | A one-off search of a date range of your Gmail for financial attachments to approve and import. |
| Indexation / CII | Raising the cost of an asset by the Cost Inflation Index of the sale year over the purchase year. |
| Ingestion failure | A record kept when a file, row or email could not be processed, with its raw data, for review or automatic retry (the "dead-letter queue"). |
| Installment schedule | The month-by-month list of an RD's (or Post Office RD/SSY's) installments with Mark paid / Undo. |
| Intraday (speculative) | A buy and sell of the same security on the same day; taxed as speculative business income under Sec. 43(5). |
| Invested | On asset-class pages: the cost of the units you still hold, including charges. |
| Khata | The tenant's running ledger: charges ("You gave") and money in ("You got"), with a balance. |
| KVP | Kisan Vikas Patra (Post Office). |
| live / live from Gmail | A bank balance last updated automatically from a bank alert e-mail. |
| Loan given | Money you lent to someone; what they still owe counts as an asset. |
| Loan taken | Money you borrowed from a lender and are repaying; counts as a liability. |
| Locked | A feature your plan does not include. It shows "<feature> is locked" with **View plans**. |
| Look-through | Your exposure to the stocks, sectors and bonds inside your funds, weighted by what you hold. |
| Lot | The contract size of an F&O instrument; quantities are shown as units with "×<lot>". |
| LRS | Liberalised Remittance Scheme: up to USD 250,000 per person per financial year sent abroad. |
| LTP | Last traded price used to value a stock, ETF or F&O contract. |
| Luhn check | The checksum every card number carries; catches a mistyped digit. |
| Mailback | A registrar's "email me my statement" request; the CAS arrives by email locked with a password. |
| Make rental | Creates a linked Rental record from an owned property. |
| Managed member | A family member with no login whose books another member keeps; cannot sign in until they take the account over. |
| Market rate | The lowest current published minimum rate for your loan type among tracked lenders. |
| May have lapsed / Cover has ended | A premium past its grace period (or past its due date with no grace) with no payment recorded. |
| MCLR | Marginal cost of funds based lending rate — a lender's internal benchmark; floating loans here use its 1-year MCLR, reset yearly. |
| MIS | Post Office Monthly Income Scheme. |
| Model portfolio | A set of target weights per asset bucket. Four are created for you (one per risk category) on your first assessment. |
| Monitored sender | An email address (or `@domain`) whose emails the app is allowed to read for financial events. |
| Needs attention | The Documents card holding files that are still being read or need a password, review or assignment. |
| Needs password | Import status: the file is encrypted and none of the automatic passwords opened it. |
| Net after debts | Dashboard figure: Total Net Worth minus outstanding loans and credit-card balances. |
| Net saving | Interest saved by refinancing minus switching costs. |
| Net worth over time | Dashboard chart of your net worth after liabilities, from one snapshot taken each night at 23:45 IST. |
| Next premium due | The date of the earliest unpaid premium; when entered on a new policy, earlier premiums count as already paid ("untracked"). |
| Next rate reset | The date your floating loan's rate is next revised to its benchmark. |
| no price | No current price is available for the holding, so no profit or loss is shown. |
| Nominee (Succession) | A person who receives read-only access to the information you chose after release. |
| Nominee only (will ownership) | An asset paid to its nominee rather than passing under the will; cannot be gifted. |
| Nominees notified | Succession stage in which nominees are told access opens in 7 days. |
| NSC | National Savings Certificate (Post Office). |
| Off-track | A goal whose needed yearly return is higher than the expected return you entered. |
| Ombudsman | The Insurance Ombudsman, to whom an unresolved complaint can be taken (claims up to ₹50 lakh). |
| Options Chain | On the F&O page, the options section listing your CE/PE positions (not an exchange option chain). |
| Outstanding (loan) | The balance still owed, taken as the opening balance of the next unpaid EMI on or after today. |
| Overdue / This week / This month / Later | Alert bands: past due; due in 7 days or fewer; in 30 days or fewer; beyond 30 days. |
| Overlap | Σ min(weight in fund A, weight in fund B) over securities both funds hold. |
| Override list | Your approved products for a bucket; when non-empty, the Advisor names these instead of the house methodology's pick. |
| Owner (family) | Family member who manages members and sees every member's data without caps. |
| Parser | The reader that recognises one document format (for example Zerodha contract note, CAMS/KFintech CAS) and extracts its transactions; its name and version are stored on each imported row. |
| Partial | Import status meaning some rows were added and some failed (stored as COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS). |
| Passbook | The EPF/PPF statement of contributions, interest and withdrawals. |
| Pending tenant reminders | Email/SMS rent reminders waiting for the landlord's approval before sending. |
| Personal view | The default view showing only your own data. The opposite is a family view chosen from **Switch view**. |
| Pillar | A group of metrics in a fund's score (for example Returns, Consistency, Cost). |
| Plan | Your subscription level: **Free**, **Plus**, **Family** or **Pro/Advisor**. Each plan includes everything in the plans below it; a paid plan lasts 30 days (monthly) or 365 days (annual) from payment and then returns to Free. |
| Planning | Sidebar group with Goals, Will Maker, Succession, Tax Planning and AI connectors. |
| Plus | Paid plan that adds the full tax/CA report catalog, account-aggregator auto-import, more portfolios, AI insights and the AI Assistant, goal projections, and the other Plus features listed on the Pricing page. |
| PMS | Portfolio Management Service. |
| Portfolio | A named container for holdings and transactions, used to separate, for example, long-term investments from trading or goal-based money. Free allows 1 portfolio. |
| Portfolio Assistant | The AI Assistant chat panel opened from the floating button. |
| Portfolio group | A bundle of several portfolios viewed together ("New group" on the Portfolios page). |
| Portfolio Score | Sidebar name for the **Financial Health Score** page: one number summarising emergency readiness, investing discipline, debt load, diversification, insurance and goal progress, recalculated every 24 hours. |
| Portfolio value | Dashboard figure for tradable and accrual holdings only; excludes real estate, vehicles and insurance. |
| Portfolio value over time | Dashboard chart of the market value of the selected portfolios by day; only stocks use past prices, other holdings are at cost on past days. |
| PPF & EPF | Public Provident Fund and Employees' Provident Fund, shown together on one page. |
| PRAN | Permanent Retirement Account Number of an NPS account. |
| Prepayment | An extra payment towards principal, outside the EMIs. |
| Pro/Advisor | Top paid plan for accountants and advisors: adds the full accounting module, unlimited portfolios and clients, and F&O-heavy reports (Schedule 43), on top of Family. |
| Professional | A CA or advisor you invite into your books from Account Access |
| PUC | Pollution Under Control certificate; its expiry is tracked as "PUC" / "PUC / Emission". |
| Rate type | Whether a loan's rate is Fixed, Floating or Not sure. |
| RC | Registration certificate of a vehicle; the source of make, model, owner and expiry details. |
| RD | Recurring deposit: monthly installments, each recorded as its own entry. |
| Reach strip | The Sees / Can / Until summary under each professional on Account Access |
| Realised gain | Gain or loss locked in by a sale. |
| Recommendation | One suggested move from the Advisor engine, with reasoning, figures and a status: Open, Accepted, Snoozed, Done or Dismissed. |
| Record it anyway | Button that saves a transaction even though an identical one already exists. |
| Recorded balances | Dated balances you entered for a bank account; they draw its balance history. |
| Reduce tenure / Reduce EMI | What a prepayment does: keep the EMI and finish earlier, or keep the end date and pay a smaller EMI. |
| Redundancy | Value-weighted mean pairwise overlap between your funds. |
| REIT / InvIT | Real Estate / Infrastructure Investment Trust units. |
| Remember me on this device | Sign-in choice: keep the session after the browser closes (ticked) or end it with the tab |
| Reminder | An alert you create yourself on the Alerts page (type Custom). |
| Rent receipt | One month's expected rent for a tenancy, with status Expected, Received, Partial, Overdue or Skipped. |
| Repo rate (EBLR) | A floating loan linked to the RBI repo rate (external benchmark lending rate); resets at least quarterly. |
| Report for | The picker that chooses whose figures a download covers: you, one family member, or the whole family. |
| Reset code | 6-digit code emailed by "Forgot password?"; valid 15 minutes, 5 tries; only the newest works |
| Residuary (By percentage) | Everything not given as a specific gift or fixed amount, shared in percentages totalling 100%. |
| Risk profile | Your category (Conservative, Balanced, Growth, Aggressive), score 0–100 and tax slab, set by the 7-question risk assessment on the Advisor page. |
| Risk-o-meter | SEBI's risk label for a scheme (Low to Very High). |
| Scan now | Runs all alert checks for your account immediately. |
| Schedule 112 | The ITR schedule for long-term gains on other assets, with or without indexation. |
| Schedule 112A | The ITR schedule for long-term gains on listed equity and equity-oriented funds, with an annual exemption (₹1,25,000 from FY 2024-25). |
| Scheduled cashflow | The 12-month forecast of loan EMIs, rent due, premiums and deposit maturities. |
| SCSS | Senior Citizen Savings Scheme. |
| Seat | A place in a family; held by each active member and each unaccepted invitation. 3 included by default. |
| Sec. 111A | Short-term gains on listed equity with STT paid, taxed at a flat rate. |
| Set-off / carry forward | Using losses to reduce gains in the same year; unused losses are carried to later years. |
| Settle up | Recording a payment from one member to another (Cash, UPI or Other) that reduces what they owe. |
| Settlement price | The exchange's closing settlement price for a contract on expiry day, used to book the expiry close. |
| SGB | Sovereign Gold Bond: government bond priced on gold, tracked in units of 1 gram. |
| Shared portfolio | A portfolio attached to a family, visible to all members and writable by owners and contributors. |
| Shared with nominees | Succession stage after release. |
| Sharing area | One of 11 data areas a connected chatbot may read (Investments … Documents) |
| Sign and store | Step 9: recording the signing date, two witnesses and a copy of the signed will. |
| Simplify debts | Group setting that suggests the fewest payments needed to settle everyone, instead of person-to-person debts. |
| Slab rate | Your personal income-tax rate, used for non-equity short-term gains, intraday and F&O. |
| Source hash | A fingerprint stored on each imported row so the same row is never added twice. |
| Specific gift | A share of a particular asset given to a person. |
| Split group | A shared ledger of expenses and payments among people, in one currency (types Trip, Home, Couple, Other; 1:1 ledgers with a friend show as "Just you two"). |
| SSY | Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana. |
| Staking Reward | A crypto income entry; listed but does not add units. |
| Starter portfolio | "My Portfolio", created automatically when setup opens |
| Statement | One month's credit card bill: amount, minimum due and due date. |
| Statement day / Due day | The day of the month a card's bill is generated / payment is due. |
| STCG / LTCG | Short-term / long-term capital gain, decided by how long the units were held before sale. |
| Stock photo | A generic image matched by make and model, not a photo of the user's own vehicle. |
| Succession | The page where you name nominees who get read-only access to your financial picture after inactivity or on a date you choose. |
| Sum assured / Cover | The amount a policy pays on the insured event; shown as **Cover** on the policy card and as **Sum assured** for life policies. |
| Surrender value | What the insurer would pay if you end a whole life, endowment or ULIP policy early; entered from the insurer's quote. |
| Switch view | Header menu (shown only to family members) to switch between **Personal view** and a family's combined view. |
| Switching costs | Processing fee (% of outstanding) plus other charges paid to move a loan to a new lender. |
| Sync Kite | Pulls today's F&O trades from a connected Zerodha (Kite) account. |
| Tax & MIS downloads | The catalog of 42 print-style reports on the Reports page. |
| Tax-loss harvesting | Selling holdings that are at a loss before 31 March to offset gains booked in the same year. |
| TCS | Tax collected at source on remittances; 20% above ₹7 lakh a year in this app's guidance. |
| Tenancy | One tenant's lease on a rental property, with monthly rent and due day. |
| TER | Total expense ratio — the yearly charge a fund deducts, as a % of assets. |
| Timing | Your XIRR minus the fund CAGR over the same period. |
| Today's change | Dashboard figure: the day's move on market-priced holdings only (equities, mutual funds, crypto, gold). |
| Total active monthly income | The sum of income entries marked **Currently active**. |
| Total invested | Dashboard figure: the sum of cost basis across all holdings (what you put in). |
| Total Net Worth | The dashboard's headline figure: investments + real estate + vehicles, before loans and credit-card liabilities ("Gross"). |
| TPA | Third-party administrator that settles health claims for an insurer. |
| Trade Tape | The F&O list of trades, newest first. |
| Transfer In / Transfer Out | Crypto moved into or out of a wallet/exchange; counted as a buy or sell at the price entered. |
| Turnover (F&O) | ICAI tax-audit turnover: for futures and options, the sum of absolute realised profit and loss per closed trade. |
| Two-factor sign-in | Signing in with an authenticator-app code in addition to your password, switched on in Settings; required for the professional workspace and admin tools. |
| TWR | Time-weighted return for your whole account, shown beside XIRR on the Dashboard. |
| UAN | Universal Account Number, the 12-digit EPF member number. |
| ULIP | Unit-linked Insurance Plan. |
| Unrealised P&L | Dashboard figure: current value minus invested, across holdings only; not annualised. |
| Untracked premium | A premium due before the date you started tracking the policy; treated as paid. |
| Upgrade | Header button and sidebar card that open the plans page; not shown on Pro/Advisor. |
| Utilization | Card outstanding as a percentage of its credit limit. |
| VAHAN | The government vehicle registration database; "Paste VAHAN SMS" reads the SMS reply from its SMS service. |
| Verdict | The per-fund conclusion of an analysis run: Hold, Monitor, Review, Switch candidate, Not enough data. |
| Verification code | 6-digit code emailed at sign-up; valid 10 minutes, 5 tries |
| Verifier | The one nominee asked to confirm, during the notice period, whether something has happened to you. |
| View only / Make some changes / Keep the books | What a professional may change in a client's books: nothing, some of the four areas (books, transactions, imports, fair market values), or all four. |
| Viewer (family) | Member who sees other members' data within their caps, read-only. |
| Visibility caps | The asset classes and non-portfolio categories a contributor or viewer may see of other members. |
| Voucher | A double-entry record; types JOURNAL, PAYMENT, RECEIPT, CONTRA, PURCHASE, SALES. "auto" marks one generated from your activity. |
| Whenever (flexible) | A loan given repaid in any amounts at any time, with optional daily simple interest. |
| Who keeps their books | The member (keeper) allowed to open a managed member's account. |
| Will Maker | Guided tool to "write a simple will under Indian law from your EveryPaisa data, check it, and download it to sign." |
| Write off | Forgive what a borrower still owes and close the loan given. |
| XIRR | Annualised return that accounts for when money went in and out. Shown per holding on a portfolio page; the Dashboard shows a simple average of the portfolios' XIRRs. |
| §112A headroom | Annual exemption on long-term gains from equity funds left this financial year after realised gains. |
